Together, they embark on an unexpected journey to discover whether love can exist even for those who believe it never could.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Flowers Are Bait" (꽃은 미끼야) by Geon Eomul Nyeo (건어물녀).
In these times when it is difficult to completely guard "oneself" due to social and gender issues, the friendship story of four people delivering warm comfort to all the wounded people in the world.
dramas.t: It's Okay to Be Sensitive Season 3

dramas.syn:
Lee Jeong Eun, a beauty industry marketer, juggles work and her 7-year-old daughter's education while harboring long-buried resentment toward her mother. Her immature husband, Hong Jae Man, struggles at work but prioritizes family. Yun Ji A, a children's art therapist, raised Jeong Eun alone and discovers a new world when she takes her grandson to the academy. There, she meets Lee Yeong Uk, an English professor who finds renewed excitement in life.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Riding Life" (라이딩 인생) by Go Seon Mi (고선미).
An attractive babysitter, who graduated from a prestigious university, begins to work as a babysitter for 3 children from a wealthy couple. The attractive babysitter begins to change.
A drama tells the story of 7 idol trainees and their daily hardships.
dramas.t: Let's Only Walk The Flower Road

dramas.syn: 18-year-old Young Baek, a high school student from Daegu, moves to Seoul to pursue his dream of becoming a rapper. Despite facing hardships, he stays determined and attends Doobak High School. There, he meets Ha Jin, a fellow student with dreams of becoming a writer, and the two develop feelings for each other, though Ha Jin harbors a secret. At the same school, Tae Hwang, a rapper with wealthy, supportive parents, becomes rivals with Young Baek, while Ki Ha befriends him, hoping to find a girlfriend.

Yeon Woo a highschool boy meets Da Mi, he feels an instant connection after he notices her bright red sneakers. Da Mi & Yeon Woo tell their story, reminiscing over the past, how they became friends and how their relationship grew and developed over the years.

Belonging to the wealthiest class and as the daughter of an influential chaebol family in Korea, Ji Eun grew up with everything. When she meets Se Hoon, who comes from an underprivileged family, he treats her like no other, and she falls in love with him. Although Ji Eun's family opposes their relationship, they get married. However, due to reoccurring conflicts, Ji Eun and Se Hoon become exhausted and end their marriage. Ten years later, fate ironically reverses their lives. Se Hoon, who is now a successful man, buys Ji Eun's house out of revenge. But when he stands in front of her as Willian Jang, he only wants to help her. Nonetheless, there is Mi Ran, with whom he is in a serious relationship with, and next to Ji Eun is her new love, Jung Min, who is devoted to her. This drama is the 2020 version of the intertwined fates of four people's love.
The series is a fantasy comic web drama that tells a story of three students, who were studying in Seowon during the Joseon period accidently time travel and arrive at present-day Seowon in 2020.

Kim Woo Ri is a 20-year-old freshman. She dreamed of being a normal kid who could live free and independent. However, because the coronavirus is spreading, it makes her unable to do anything.

One day she had a big fight with her mother. She wanted to live alone, but her mother wouldn't let her. The next day, she order her favorite food, and suddenly she was sent back to year 2002.

Even though Oh Bom is in a difficult financial situation, she is still bright and positive. She works part-time work at a factory. Kang Ma Roo is a kind and simple young man. He is naive about the world. An Tae Ho is the section chief of a company. He is an ambitious man. He approaches Choi Ah Ran for his own gain and marries her. Choi Ah Ran is the heiress of a large company. She is smart, but has a painful past. Her younger sister went missing and her parents abandoned her.

A story of maternal love. There are two mothers who have a strong bond with their child. Hong Jiwon holds hands with the devil to save her son. She gives away her body and soul to him, her life and her money. And, because of her great affection towards her child, she finds herself in conflict with Son Yeori who is also a mother. Under the name of a mother, the two women know how to show mother's instinctive love.
Yeong Su’s family arrive in a new city while hiding their past. As they face an even greater evil force, they carry out a hellish revenge to protect one another.

One difference that separates humans from animals is that people have emotions. So describing the emotions of different characters in a TV drama is an important part of the storytelling process. What is it like for a person to love another person? What is it like for a person to forgive another? This TV drama is made with the premise of influencing people to become gentler and stronger human beings.
Tells the story of Kang Yoo Hyuk, a North Korean defector who transferred to Hyesung High School.

“Anniversary Anyway” is a Naver V original web drama that tells the story of six teenagers who are experiencing first love as they each get ready to celebrate an anniversary.
Hongseok has taken on the role of a sharp-minded 18-year-old boy named Hong Woo Jae who is a hopeless romantic for Cha Se Yi. Gyujin will play Gong Doo Jin, a boy who finds love more difficult than everything else in the world.

Depicts the story of a man who comes back from the dead nine times to save a woman. A woman once again falling in love with him after reuniting with him for the tenth time. Nam Ji O, a high school senior preparing for the national Taekwondo team trials, and Cha Gyeol, a boy with a mysterious charm.

A tear-jerking melodrama about a stormy romance, 100 years in the making. Their reason to die.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "My Reason to Die" (내가 죽기로 결심한 것은) by YUJU (유주).

Gyeo Ul witnesses her husband Yu Jin having an affair with her friend Ae Ra who becomes the target of her revenge. It causes Gyeo Ul to lose her eyesight and suffer from lock-in syndrome out of shock.  

Gyeo Ul gets involved with Se Rin, an heiress who owns everything. Se Rin is an arrogant and cold-hearted woman who looks down on people and does not hesitate to take revenge on whoever stabs her in the back.

A story of a woman who was raised as a tool for her mother’s revenge and her dangerous love life will be introduced.

Carrie Jung lost her husband and child. She now lives only take revenge on those responsible for their deaths. Carrie Jung raises Han Yoo Jin as a tool in her revenge plan. Han Yoo Jin is a smart and beautiful woman, but she falls in love with a man who she should not love.

The sequel to the romantic story "Love After School 2" will tell us about the relationship between the heroes of the first season. Bang and Hong were loyal friends at school, and it was only as adults that they realized they were in love with each other. They are still having fun together and getting ready for the upcoming wedding. But the couple will have to face unexpected problems and pass a real test of their feelings. Will they cope?

Can you find someone whom you saw once in a city with a population of 10 million people? A young Dutch man, Jan, flies 8000 km from the Netherlands to Seoul in search of the girl he fell in love with at first sight. He wanders into Itaewon, a neighborhood known for its large population of foreigners and diversity, and meets unique Koreans, such as Kim Jung Nam, the legendary owner of restaurants in Itaewon, an oddball named Man Doo, and his beautiful stewardess sister, Ha Yeong, who go out of their way to help Jan find his love.

Cheon Nara, whose name literally means ‘heaven’, is a normal lady working a normal office job who suddenly starts seeing glimpses of a man in suits smirking at her. She lives alone and of course, freaks out when she feels that there is someone following her on her way home and makes the decision to buy a taser. It turns out that the man is no ordinary man; he is a devil who appears before her, black wings and all, to offer her three wishes. Nara’s response to his revelation is something Mr. Devil has not prepared for: she completely ignores him and his offer, doubting her vision. He tries to prove his identity, only to lead her into believing that she has a disease and has started having hallucinations.

Yeo Won, once aspiring to be a reporter, becomes a housewife after an unexpected pregnancy. Now busy managing her family’s finances, caring for her child, and dealing with her troublesome in-laws, her life takes a turn after her husband’s accident. Meanwhile, Chun Dong, raised in an orphanage and saved by Hwang Byung Rae through a heart surgery, becomes a lawyer, but works for Byung Rae.

Japanese high schooler Hirose Hana dreams of becoming a manager for top pop groups. She transfers to Segi Art High School, a South Korean school that has produced some of the Korean entertainment industry’s brightest stars.

Her first few days are a success, and she soon strikes up a friendship with the handsome and popular aspiring singer Koo Eun Ho. But she soon discovers that egos at the school are fragile, and that her own success may be stoking resentment in others. Worse still, someone at the school has learned that she is harboring a secret – and threatens to make it public. Is disaster in the cards for her, or will her new friends help her fulfill her dreams at this highly competitive school?

Explore the fierce desires and ambitions of people within the glamorous world of K-pop.

Se Eun is a powerful entertainment executive in South Korea. She is ambitious, glamorous, and exceptionally skilled at her job. Determined to make tough decisions and risk everything for the revival of the idol group she personally created, she navigates overwhelming emotions in many unexpected situations.

Seung Hui is an obsessive fan who will do whatever it takes to meet her favorite idol. Her character unfolds through a deep and conflicting mix of love, hate, and fierce devotion.
Eun Bang Wool falls in love with the man who received a heart transplant from her ex-boyfriend. She faces secrets around her.
A fantasy romantic comedy drama in which the protagonist, who drinks a special coffee that allows them to go back to the past, struggles to capture the hearts of lovers with the power of coffee.

A reporter who was formerly a member of a girl group realizes the meaning of life while going on a requested trip.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Tabiya Okaeri" (旅屋おかえり) by Harada Maha (原田マハ).

'Momin's Room' will talk about how today's youth deals with love, friendship, and family while weaving in informational content about copyright. The main character is 23-year-old Momin, who moves from Jeju Island to Seoul and builds lasting friendships.
A man’s life spirals downward after his fiance dies just days before their wedding.

It tells the story of a bank auditor pursuing justice and policy changes at a time when an economic bubble is collapsing. No Dae Ho is an honest and sincere man. He works as a branch manager at Daehan Bank, which is located in a small city. The branch is on a soon-to-be shutdown list. Surprisingly, No Dae Ho is promoted to the auditor at the bank’s headquarters in Seoul. No Dae Ho then faces corruption at the bank.

~~ Adapted from the manga “Kansayaku Nozaki Shuhei” written by Ryouka Shuu and illustrated by Shigeru Noda.
It details a series of events in which the inexperienced proprietor of a coffee shop becomes involved with the members of a fictional band known as 'Leopold'.
A hyper-realistic drama depicting the daily lives of clumsy women in their 30s in the fashion industry and their joys and sorrows at work.

The story takes place in a high school. Hari attends a high school with her two friends, Ka Eun and Hyun Woo. Rumors are circulating that one of the students in the school, Park Joo Min, is possessed by a ghost. Although Hari is skeptical of the rumors, strange events start happening in the school. A guy named Kang Lim shows up and claims that Hari and he were friends. Who is this mysterious boy and are the rumors true?

“Hanging On” is about a family who is far from being normal. The family hustles hard every day just to survive. When they are 'hanging on' they can stay out of trouble, but it is easier said than done.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Hanging On” (놓지마 정신줄) written by Shin Tae Hoon (신태훈) and illustrated by Na Seung Hoon (나승훈)

The two best friends are polar opposites. Cin De Ri works for a cosmetics company but prefers not to wear makeup due to a traumatic incident in college. Her best friend is Gae Mo Ran, the impeccable and gorgeous beauty host. When Cin De Ri stands in for Mo Ran on a blind date with the handsome Lee Jun Yeol, she becomes smitten with him. But Mo Ran then decides she wants Jun Yeol for herself and tries to seduce him.

Angry, Cin De Ri decides her Plain Jane days are over and uses a mysterious compact that can conjure three makeup fairies – Fairy Won Hye, Fairy Hwal Ran, and Fairy Dae Shik – to transform her into a beautiful woman. Wang Sae Son is mesmerized by the sudden change in Cin De Ri. But the compact can only be used up to eight times. What will happen to Cin De Ri when she runs out of magic transformations?
Witness the sweet changes of heart for three inter-generational families over the love between a very special couple.
It tells the story of Do Yeon, a high school girl who may seem cold but is very easy-going, and her three boy friends, who each have a different charm.

A bittersweet romantic fantasy about a man who looks exactly like a woman's deceased first love. The story follows a woman who can see the past and a man who must hide his own past. As their lives become intertwined, they are drawn into a series of unexpected events that unfold into a poignant and sweet romance.

Cha Eun Dong, an upright and patient woman from humble beginnings, faces turmoil after being betrayed by someone she trusted. Consumed by vengeance, she vows retribution. Meanwhile, Kang Tae In, a morally driven man who rose from a lowly employee to chairman of F Sports Group, broke his only promise to Eun Dong, choosing his ambition over her.

Set in a lawless city during the redevelopment boom of the 1980s ahead of the Seoul Olympics, The story follows Paeng I, the sole survivor of a gold shop incident who is thrust into the criminal underworld after taking possession of the gold.

Joining forces with members of a marginal organization, he becomes entangled in a dangerous drug operation. Cold, calculating, and relentless, Paeng I rises within the trade, willing to cut off allies and eliminate even those closest to him in pursuit of his ambitions, igniting betrayal and violent conflict between rival groups.

Alongside him are Saeng Dak, a survival-driven gang member, and Bok Hui, his first love and a key supplier in the operation. As their lives intertwine, their choices drive events in unpredictable directions. Against a backdrop of rapid social change, the trio risks everything on a high-stakes scheme, as greed, betrayal,…

Mr. Yoo is the section chief of one of the worst performing sections in the company. One day while working late, he is chased by several men and is then hit by a truck. He is the 4th victim of the strange incidents that has been occurring at the company that resulted in 3 deaths. However, all of the victims had one thing in common other than working in the same company, which was that all of them had a music box given to them as a gift.

Korea has been taken over by aliens, and three agents from two different timelines spearhead the war against them.  An unknown monster strikes them! One day, a single scream in an urgent phone call was heard.

A top-level national secret organization, aka BUG (Bureau of Unidentified Genes), ​​is dispatched to catch the unknown beast that appears in the city center. Veteran Jung Bong, principleist Hyo Chan, and passionate newcomer Ki Woong, the three of Korea's top special agents, are starting to counterattack!
Two men are held captive naked, forced to engage in physical intimacy, and filmed by a male kidnapper.

Cha Ji Min is a single woman who pursues a slow living lifestyle. She worked as a local news reporter for a current affairs magazine, but that magazine was shut down. She then starts work as an editor for digital magazine "New Normal Zine" under the same parent company.  

There, her new boss is Chief Editor Song Ro Ji. Cha Ji Min and Song Ro Ji are familiar with each other, as they started to work for the parent company in the same year. Song Ro Ji is a workaholic and totally different from Cha Ji Min. Now, Cha Ji Min tries to survive there.

A meticulous and intense revenge chronicle in which two women who return under false identities uncover the truth and sins hidden in the Adel family. 

Kim Myeong Hui, the older sister of her twin Kim Dan Hui, is a kind-hearted nurse who dreams of a normal family life, but encounters an unexpected truth and meets a tragic fate. Kim Dan Hui, the younger sister, learns the truth behind her sister's death and decides to abandon her own life and live under her sister's name. She embarks on a meticulous quest for revenge to take over the Adel Group. 

Chloe Lee, who, after losing her family in an unexpected accident, abandons both her name and identity to pursue revenge and takes on the role of a world-renowned brand consultant. Her ordinary life is shattered in an instant, and she enters the Adel Group under a new identity, meticulously plotting revenge. However, her plans begin to falter…

There are four young men and women who try to fiercely overcome the difficulties while fighting against the prejudices of the world. Bo Ra, a rising weather caster, Dae Ro, a passionate delivery boy and a youth creator, Ah Ri, a fearless broadcasting writer, and Jun Soo, sharp-tempered but competent CEO of a start-up. The fierce process of these four youth’s growth takes place at a beautiful flower shop. Watching Bo Ra who gives the weather forecast every dawn is Dae Ro’s only healing time during his hectic life as an orphan, delivery boy, and creator. One day, he attends a ceremony as a winner which Bo Ra hosts. It is a family drama that depicts how they form a connection and overcome difficulties with a warm gaze.

“Supper” is a shabby Korean Diner in the countryside near a small train station. Young Shin is in her third year of high school, but while her classmates go straight to academies after school, she rushes to the market to buy cheap ingredients for the diner.  The regular customers who bought daily meal tickets for 4 dollars, and enjoyed a generous, delicious warm dinner, became the “Supper” family.  Since Young Shin was little, she learned how to cook from Gyung Soo, the owner of the Diner. She grew up with Da Jung, Jung Hoon and Oh Bok.  Jung Hoon, moved to the countryside with his father after he divorced Jung Hoon’s mother. Oh Bok, was raised by his grandmother and uncle, after his parents abandoned him.  Da Jung, and her parents, ate at “Supper” because both her parents worked. They became closer than most siblings over 12 years. Four young people show up in Gyung Soo’s life,…
A story about a heartless mother who betrayed her father and turned away from her sick younger brother for love and desire, and a daughter who dreams of revenge against such mother.

Jung Ba Reum’s planner might be full, but one thing she desperately needs in her diary is a date. When she is lured into joining a programming club by her friend’s hot coworker, it looks like there might be hope for her. But will her inexperience lead to her downfall? And why does she keep running into his bad-tempered friend instead?

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Romance 101" (바른연애 길잡이) by Nam Su (남수).
A heady drama producer, an assistant director, and an actor who hasn't debuted after seven years in the industry navigate the world of television drama production.

Joo A Ran is a mukbang YouTuber, who is deeply traumatized by eating food. She meets Ahn Sul Ha, who is a chef that's passionate about food. They soon get themselves into a housekeeper and house owner relationship.
A pure, harmless, no-MSG teen drama depicting the growth process of high school cover song club friends meeting each other and finding their dreams.

Han Sa Rang is a scriptwriter and is working with PD Woo. She still has lingering feeling for her ex-boyfriend turned-friend Nam Woo Jung. When PD Woo confesses to her, will she move forward with him, or will Woo Jung hold her back?

'The Waking' is a story about an organization that manages giants and an organization that opposes them. Jun Ho, is a character who lives an honest life while organizing a cold storage, but accidentally acquires a stone that grants him great power and gets involved in an incident. Jun Ho's body grows larger due to the stone's power, and he suddenly becomes a 'giant' and infiltrates the organization.

A romantic drama that focuses on the love stories of high school best friends Min Joo, Kang Chan, Bang Hee, and Hyun Beom. Everything begins when Min Joo, who develops an unrequited love for Kang Chan for a long time ends up having her deceased brother Dae Yeon’s soul take control of her body. To fulfill his younger sister’s one-sided love, Dae Yeon does his best to win over Kang Chan’s heart.
A drama about people who face hate and conflict while learning to forgive and understand the meaning of love and happiness.
‘Start love’ is a romance drama of a man and a woman in their 20’s that will depict the love story of them comically

Baek Seol Hui is a single mother with a bright and positive personality, raising her daughter alone. Baek Seol Hui runs a small restaurant. She has an ordinary, but happy daily life with her daughter. Her life suddenly changes due to an unexpected case, in which her daughter is the victim, but is turned into the perpetrator. Baek Seol Hui vows revenge on those who are responsible for that.
dramas.t: The Woman Who Swallowed the Sun

dramas.syn:
It tells the story and episodes of the 10 close boys who have lived together since high school. A group of young boys who find the destination and explore the universe in the early days of university. They were expecting to meet paradise when they entered university. This is a great chance for those who are sad and want to be alone. However, when they started to experience it, they realised that that was not true. They portray the love, friendship, and dreams of the 20s.

A group of boys who face problems in their lives and want to enjoy their life by making friends and girlfriends, but they are wrong.
In 2008, we were strong and full of passion! It tells the youth growth romance stories of boys and girls of that time.

Twin sisters O Jang Mi and Ma Seo Rin live completely opposite lives. Jang Mi is a warm and honest woman who fights for what’s right, while Seo Rin, a reckless chaebol heiress, is used to getting her way no matter the cost. When fate intertwines their worlds, they find themselves walking paths meant for the other; uncovering painful secrets, unexpected love, and dangerous rivalries that blur the line between justice and desire.

Their fates become further entangled with brothers Kang Baek Ho, a kind-hearted lawyer who believes in doing good, and Kang Jun Ho, a cold, perfectionist chef who hides a fragile heart beneath his stoic exterior. Both brothers are drawn to Jang Mi in different ways, setting off a storm of emotions that none of them can escape.

Meanwhile, Jin Hong Ju, an ambitious Dream Hotel employee consumed by jealousy and obsession, sees Jang Mi as the obstacle standing…

The story follows the love, friendship and betrayal between two women: Hong Se Yeon and Eun Kyung Hye.
Hong Se Yeon works as a personal shopper. She is outgoing and a positive person, but she is betrayed by people whom she loved. She begins to take revenge on those who betrayed her.
Eun Kyung Hye is the only child of a CEO. Her life looks perfect, but she has a fear that she will get abandoned. Because of her fear, she has an impulse control disorder and gets compulsive.

Kim Ji Hun and Kong Hu Gyeong, two strangers in a foreign country, meet by chance and spend an unforgettable, dreamlike day and night together. Though they know their connection should end once they return to Korea, they are unable to resist the growing attraction between them.

Back home, what was meant to be a fleeting encounter lingers, and their reunion sets off a turbulent course that begins to crack the stability of their lives. Ji Hun, a man with a stable career and a happy marriage, finds his world starting to unravel, while his wife, Lee Seon Hui, is confronted with shocking truths about their relationship.

At the same time, Seon Hui’s younger brother, Dae Hui, becomes entangled in an unexpected relationship with Hu Gyeong. As the consequences of that single encounter spread, the lives of Ji Hun, Hu Gyeong, Seon Hui, and Dae Hui are gradually shaken and upended.

~~ Adapted…

Sisters Lee Hye Won and Lee Hye Ji were separated after their parents' divorce, leading them down drastically different paths. Hye Won, living with her father, appears perfect but struggles under the control of her stepmother and is engaged to Yoon Ji Chang, the son of JY Group's owner, Yoon Yi Cheol.

Hye Ji, raised in poverty and abuse, adopts the name Bae Do Eun to escape her past. She begins an affair with Yi Cheol, seeking a fresh start. Their paths cross again for the first time since childhood, revealing the emotional scars they both carry.

"22 Flower Road" is a webdrama about young people who share what they have and do not have with each other and become adults. It is expected to bring about realistic empathy with its highlights through the youthful lives of five young people.

A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice!

I’m Koo Yeong Jin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?!

Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jae Rim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant.

No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

“You need to go into politics.”

And I’ll get my revenge.

A political genius ghost, Koo Yeong Jin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jae Rim, for the ultimate combo in.

~~ Adapted from the web novel “The Congressman Sends My Condolences" (의원님이 보우하사) by Kim…

When it comes to love, Ha Joon is about the farthest thing from an expert that you can get. With almost no dating experience, the closest Ha Joon has ever gotten to having a long-term relationship is the one he has with his dog, Meongoo. Now in his twenties, Ha Joon is starting to feel that raising a dog is great, but it would be nice to have an actual human by his side.

Terrified of going through his entire twenties without a proper relationship, Ha Joon agrees to visit a dating consultation company with some of his college friends. While there, Ha Joon finds himself crossing paths with Do Hee, a pretty young lady who looks exactly like his first love. Incredibly unlucky when it comes to love, Do Hee's only true companion is her cat Anna. Even so, Do Hee refuses to give up on love.

Bonding over their mutual affection for their pets, Ha Joon and Do Hee find themselves drawing even…
dramas.t: Woof & Meow – Do you Love Me?

dramas.syn:
Crushes are waiting everywhere but found nowhere. Are you wondering where you stand with him or her?

Romantic relationships in your 20s are clumsy and incomplete. They have a crush on somebody dreaming of complete love.

"The Omniscient Viewpoint on Crushes" depicts youths that have a crush in the omniscient viewpoint.

As a single dad, Kang San works harder than anyone else to raise his daughter. He runs a side dish store and works as a nursing care worker to make ends meet. His daughter, Jan Di, a middle schooler entering her adolescence, aspires to be a K-pop idol. Although Kang San does his best for his daughter, conflicts with his adolescent daughter are inevitable. Like an accident destined to happen, Mi Rae, the adopted daughter of the Hwang Dong Food Group, shows up before him. She may be adopted, but Mi Rae is an academy art instructor with a straightforward attitude and astute qualities. What love story will unfold when Mi Rae's first love, Ju Hyuk, suddenly appears before them?
The story of Lee Se Gye, who can see one minute into the future, and Ha Na Bi, who caught his eye.

Kang Hye Mi is an office worker who's been at KS International for 4 years. She used to always be confident and energetic but lost her confidence and faith in love after witnessing her scum ex-boyfriend cheat on her. To make matters worse, her ex-boyfriend is a general manager at her company, and she can't avoid running into him. Like with all office romances, she becomes the topic of all kinds of rumors after breaking up with him. The stress and difficulties have been enough for her to consider resignation constantly.

One day, she bumps into Na Jung Gook on her way to work and misses the bus, ruining an important presentation. Ironically, Na Jung Gook is joining Kang Hye Mi's team as a new employee, and they become a mentor and mentee. Na Jung Gook is a rare newcomer who is passionate about everything, without avoiding his boss, and who lives by maintaining a work-life balance.

As…

"Big Picture House” is about five people who failed to debut as idols living together in a shared house, and their stories about dreams and love. It conveys the message that failure does not equal a failed life and the belief that the time and effort used in pursuit of one dream and can be used in a different way.

After Go Ya’s dad had an affair ten years ago, she had to put college on hold and start earning money to support her mom and siblings. While her life was in the dumps, she met Min Ji Seok, who treated her special and it was the first time a boy had ever made her feel that way. They fell deeply in love. But Ji Seok’s aunt turns out to the very woman that Go Ya’s dad had an affair with. So Go Ya has to choose between Ji Seok or her mom and she and Ji Seok eventually decide to lie in order to have it both ways. “Enemies from the Past” is a story of two families that are entangled in secrets and a bad karmic connection but finally find reconciliation later on through the power of forgiveness.

A comedic investigation action drama about a king who chases after cases and a rookie royal inspector who chases after the king. The story follows King Hye Jong, a master detective who can get whatever he wishes with a flick of his hand and embodies the ultimate royal “flex,” and Yi Seo, a rookie inspector who learned everything—from romance to social skills—from books, but whose memory is unmatched.

King Hye Jong, a boastful and sharp-tongued ruler known as the ultimate authority in the peaceful Joseon era who spends his days investigating cases. He is known for blatantly insulting people to their faces, with relentless sarcasm that cuts as sharply as a blade.
The story of a man and a woman who grow closer through the medium of fictional music from a novel.
dramas.t: Love Track: A Soundtrack Like No Other

dramas.syn: A woman prepares for her remarriage to the perfect man, a second generation chaebol, but in the midst of those proceedings, she realizes that her divorce from her ex was never legally finalized. She has to lead a double life, leading both men on until things are settled. However, her ex-husband-to be is involved in an accident and develops amnesia, completely forgetting that they're no longer a married couple.

Depicts the story of Min Yeong Ju, head of a publishing company whose hands have shaped dozens of bestsellers over the past decade. Intelligent and elegant, she possesses a sharp intellect and a deep sense of empathy for people. Yet when faced with something she believes is wrong, she can turn unflinchingly cold and decisive — every inch the capable CEO.

On the day she celebrates her 60th birthday alone, the wealthy divorcée meets Jung Jae Hui, a 33-year-old freelance designer with striking looks and an irresistible charm that is difficult to escape once you fall under it, at an art museum — an encounter that begins an unexpected connection between them.

~~ Remake of the British TV series “Gold Digger" [2019].
A drama about a woman who finally becomes a part of a family after re-adoption and man who chooses love over family.

A short, cute drama about friends-to-lovers couple, with a height difference of 30 cm. Female lead is cute girl called Lee Seul and she's 155 cm, male lead and her childhood bestfriend is Min Ki, who's 187 cm tall.
dramas.t: 187 cm Male Friend vs 155 cm Female Friend

dramas.syn: When she was a teenager, Han Ka Young's father's company went bankrupt. As a result, her parents then divorced. Because of her difficult situation, Han Ka Young has taken care of the housework and her family since her teenage years. Nevertheless, she has a bright personality. Her father then starts a cosmetics company. She works at her father's company and takes her job seriously. Meanwhile, Han Ka Young has never had a boyfriend. One day, she meets Yoon Jung Han, the successor to a family owned glass factory. Han Ka Young falls in love with him.

Jung Woo, a bullied high school student, struggles to endure daily torment. When Jae Seong organizes a fighting tournament for the school's weakest students, Jung Woo becomes an unwilling participant. Determined to survive, he trains at the gym, drawing strength and inspiration from Min Ah, a new transfer student.

A story of young boys and girls who are in between jobs begins with a misunderstanding on them as an idol in the countryside. They are actually preparing together for job interviews in resort pension but start performing for African guests due to ruralists’ misunderstanding.

Jae Ho tries to find a job, but it's not easy for him. He supports himself  by working part-time jobs. Recently, his girlfriend Soo Jung dumped him after dating for 7 years. Despite his difficulties, Jae Ho's main concern is "What should I eat today?"

After working day and night for several years at an advertising company, Woon Ho almost died due to overworking, she quit her job after that. Now, it's been 3 months since she has become voluntarily unemployed. She follows her simple belief of "Let's just think about eating delicious food." 

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "A DeadbEAT's Meal" (백수세끼) by Cheese (치즈).

Chi Hwan believes in money and authority more than the law and strives to live at the top of the ladder. His mother had to face wrongful death when he was young, and he suffered from poverty and war alone. To put an end to the misery, he rose out of poverty to great wealth and became a successful chairman of Shine Cosmetics. 

Se Na, who is actually Yi Chang's biological daughter, grows up as the daughter of Chi Hwan and dreams of becoming his sole heir. She wants to be with Jin Woo, but sadly, she realizes he is in love with Hae In, Chi Hwan's biological daughter. By an ironic twist of fate, Hae In lost her mother as a child and was adopted by Yi Chang. How will the fate of the fathers and daughters unravel?
A romantic comedy drama about an application which introduces men and women within 1 km of each other.

A black comedy political sitcom about an Olympic gold medalist who was appointed as minister of Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and is facing a kidnapping incident of her husband who is a political critic.

To marry the heir of the Geonhyang Group, Cha Jeong Won enters a wealthy family under a false identity, borrowing her friend's name. However, the woman who appears before her as her mother-in-law, Han Hye Ra, is none other than Jeong Won's biological mother. Hye Ra abandoned her daughter to escape poverty and gain power. Jeong Won, scarred by a father framed for murder and a mother who left her, confronts Hye Ra as her future daughter-in-law. But just before the wedding, Jeong Won learns Hye Ra is her birth mother and vows revenge. A fierce war between two women continues amidst lies and betrayal. In a world where everything collapses with lies, only blood is real. Will the truth that the blood reveals trample on the lies and win, or will it be swallowed by another lie?
Yoo Somi likes her sister's boyfriend Nam Dong Yoon, but her best friend is Nam Dong Yoon's little brother Nam Dong Ha. How does their love story change?

Do you remember when we met for the first time?

Hyun Jin - a girl who finally meets her coveted guy.
Hee Jin - a girl that is still in love.
Ha Seul - a girl who is a childhood friend.

A vegetable seller who barely makes ends meet, Park Bok Hee has learned to work hard throughout her life. Navigating her way through an adulterous husband and unhelpful relatives, she struggles to keep her children fed and educated - until she receives the opportunity to work for the Shinsang Group as a housekeeper. My Wonderful Life follows the drama that ensues as Bok Hee - and her employers - make realizations that would change her future forever.

A youth romantic comedy set in the late 1990s. It follows a man who only knew baseball, but enrolls in a law program to pursue his first love, leading to a chaotic and heartwarming campus romance. The story captures the excitement of first love, youthful growth, and the atmosphere of that era.

Han Tae Yang, a first-year law student and former top high school baseball pitcher. On the mound, he is passionate and confident, but when it comes to love, he is straightforward and pure-hearted. His feelings for his first love are so strong that they even change the course of his life.

Song Ji U, a second-year law student. She appears bright and resilient but carries wounds and secrets she cannot easily share with anyone. Through her reunion with Tae Yang, she confronts long-buried emotions and gradually moves forward from a period in her life that had been at a standstill.
A pilot story of 'Love Playlist' about five college students.
“I Started Following Romance” combines the love story of five men and women with various Instagram functions, such as DM (direct messaging), Instagram Story, comments, likes, hashtags, and more.

Kim Hye Sung and his girlfriend of six years take time to look back on the precious people they have neglected, and try to find the lost excitement. He is a kind man, full of consideration, and with a friendly personality.
Wanting to restore the relationship with his first love, he is having trouble taking care of just himself because of work.

The story of Deul Ho continues, about a once prosecutor turned lawyer who is currently unemployed. After a legal battle, his license is revoked for a short time, and he leaves the law for some peace of mind. Unbeknownst to him, he will not be left in peace.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Dongnebyunhosa Jodeulho" (동네변호사 조들호) by Hatchling (해츨링).
dramas.t: My Lawyer, Mr. Joe 2: Crime and Punishment

dramas.syn: The relationship between two friends who live at very distant distances, but when they are needed, they console themselves, leading to a relationship full of love and difficulties.

Based on the highly confidential private family wars of Korean Chaebols, Buy King offers an exclusive glimpse into the engrossing details of the intricate family dynamics and succession wars of Korea’s wealthiest families and each member’s battle to sit at the throne of the multi-billion-dollar family business. This series will especially dive deep into how the generational differences of culture and values can affect not only the succession of power but also a family, company, and even society itself.

After being blamed since birth for destroying her family, aspiring animation writer Na Ji Ni grows up carrying wounds she can never fully speak about. Despite the harsh judgment surrounding her, Ji Ni refuses to give up on her dream of creating a Korean animation that can touch people around the world. Beneath her elegant appearance and natural talent lies a woman fighting to reclaim her own life and identity.

Standing opposite her is her mother, Na Se Ri, a former star cellist of the national orchestra who once ruled Korea’s classical music scene. Proud, ambitious, and seemingly untouchable, Se Ri has spent her life protecting the flawless image she built for herself while hiding deep fears and painful secrets behind her confidence.

As the strained mother and daughter are forced to confront the scars of their past, they cross paths with No Yeong Ju, a cheerful singing instructor who…

In this heartwarming drama, familial bonds, wealth, and sham marriages take center stage. Bu Young Bae, a Pyongyang cold noodle restaurant owner, triggers a family feud over his substantial fortune due to a health scare. Feeling betrayed, he enters into a false marriage with Gye Ok, a 33-year-old maid enticed by his wealth and large family. Despite shocking his sons, Gye Ok's strong work ethic impresses Young Bae, convincing him she can preserve his restaurant. Bu Seol Ak, Young Bae's independent and headstrong son, disapproves of Gye Ok but gets involved, bringing them closer in unexpected ways amid the family drama.

A hanok that was remodeled from an old house. Paradoxically, this place is named Modern Share House. People who have no special purpose but come here for their own reasons. Strangers with different backgrounds and values gather under one roof, sometimes conflicted, sometimes comforting, and finding the true meaning of 'togetherness.

O Dan Ha is a star of Yeonwol-dong, he is kind to everyone and always steps up to handle difficult tasks. However, he is trapped in a fate he cannot tell anyone about, and it torments him. The deeper his feelings grow for Kang Ha Ru, the more confused he becomes.

Kang Ha Ru has devoted her entire life to her family. When her mother suddenly orders her to take charge of the share house, the resentment she has suppressed for years finally erupts. But as she lives with O Dan Ha and the other share-house residents, she slowly begins to realize her own true…

A heartwarming story of a family, centered around the romance of perfectionist Ko Gyeol and clumsy Cho Eun Ae.

Ko Gyeol is an architect with an arrogant attitude. There's an untold story behind his cynical attitude and biting remarks, which he can’t tell to anyone. Cho Eun Ae is a startup developer, devoted to creating a humanistic AI world. She has a bright personality with infinite positivity, even though she is mistreated at home.

Meanwhile, Ko Min Ho is Ko Gyeol's older brother and works as a director in the strategic planning department at Gangsu Group. He only loves Seo Seung Ri, who works as a manager in the strategic planning department at Gangsu Group.

Drama series depicts the dreams, passions and friendships of young people who dream of becoming farmers.

Ha Joo Seok is in the 1st grade at a farming academy. He uses blunt language, but he is considerate of other people. Shin Yoo Jin is in the 1st grade at the same farming academy. She is smart and good at data analysis. Since she was little, she dreamed of becoming a farmer.

U Jin is an ambitious doctor who no longer believes in true love after having failed before. He views marriage as just a business. Hae Su works as an assistant chef. She dreams of getting married to the right man and having a family. U Jin soon falls in love with her, and he comes into conflict with love and ambition.

Pi Seon Ju, a devoted interior designer, is married to ambitious architect Jeon Nam Jin. However, he falls for Jin Sang A, an heiress to an architecture company, and demands a divorce. After their split, Pi Seon Ju starts anew. Meanwhile, Jin Sang A’s husband, Kim So U, prefers stability over ambition but divorces her after discovering her affair. Meeting Pi Seon Ju brings a turning point in his life.

The web drama centers on a magical mask that can transform the wearer's body and face into beautiful ones. Anita is in the popular girl group, Masera. She had previously been Lee Chae Ri, a fat and ugly woman who transformed after wearing the mask. Yoon Yoo Noh is drawn to Anita because she resembles his former lover who had passed away.

In the second season, we will be shown the stories of four couples whose feelings are just beginning to emerge, but over time they have clashes of interests that lead to litigation and a break in relations, and maybe rethink their actions in order to preserve love. In any of these couples, you can see yourself in a past relationship or present. They will show you how both parties perceive it.

Geum Tae Young studied Saju (fortune telling based on calendar dates) to write his own novel, but his novel was not successful. He happens to meet ascetic person Myung Seung, who lets Geum Tae Young use his office Myung Seung Fortune telling Hall. Myung Seung tells Geum Tae Young that he can do whatever he wants there like writing his novel again. Some customers will come in and Geum Tae Young can tell them he is Myung Seung’s pupil and read their fortunes to them. There, Geum Tae Young meets clients, predicts their futures, and help change their fates.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Cheonjae Yeogsulini Doeeotda" (천재 역술인이 되었다) by Seommaeul Mr. Kim (섬마을김씨).

Bo Ram loves her life as a tour guide at Deoksugung Palace, surrounded by good friends and a job she enjoys. She’s perfectly content—until her childhood friend, Dong Gil, reappears. Once her closest companion, they’d drifted apart over the years, but now Dong Gil is back as a performer at the palace. His presence stirs old memories and new feelings, leaving Bo Ram wondering if their rekindled connection could be something more.
'Rumor' is an office thriller web drama about the story of the heroine who died through the internal auditor's death as a victim of workplace bullying, company absurdity and rumor.

Yun Tae Ju, a former prosecutor's investigator turned ambitious lawyer, will do whatever it takes to become a partner at a prestigious law firm. His relentless pursuit of success takes a dangerous turn when he receives an invitation to a mysterious app called Code, which grants its users' wishes—but only in exchange for a price.

As Tae Ju becomes entangled in the app's web of greed and consequences, prosecutor Park Ji  Dam investigates a series of incidents connected to Code while confronting a man with whom she shares a complicated past. Along the way, Tae Ju unexpectedly joins forces with Cho Cheol Ho, a North Korean defector and hacker, while veteran detective Im Chang Jae helps him pursue the truth.

Shin Dong Yup used to be a top star, but he is not anymore. Jung Sang Hoon is a single father and he works as a loan shark. Im Cheong Ah is a Korean-Chinese single mother. They live in the Daerim Neighborhood of Seoul, South Korea and struggle to make a living.
"Idol in My Living Room" is a youth melodrama that unfolds when Joy, an excellent student at Sejong Institute, and Yeo One, a Hallyu idol, accidentally end up living in the same house.

Kang Ma Ri has always longed for her father, but her search takes an unexpected turn when three men suddenly step into her life. Lee Pung Ju, a strict but caring doctor, becomes tied to her through hidden family secrets. Kang Min Bo, the father who once raised her, returns after decades abroad, determined to reunite with the daughter he lost. And Jin Gi Sik, her affectionate uncle, insists on playing a larger role in her life, leaving Ma Ri caught in the middle of a chaotic paternity scandal.

As she struggles to untangle the truth, Ma Ri begins a clumsy but heartfelt romance with her senior colleague, Lee Gang Se. What starts as an awkward relationship soon deepens into a supportive partnership, with Gang Se standing firmly by her side as she faces secrets and hardships that could shake her family apart.

Adding to the turmoil is Ma Ri’s fiery mother, Ju Si Ra, whose impulsive nature…

It tells the story of a married couple in their 5th year of marriage, about to get divorced, and their conflict over the 'cat rights' of a cat that is like a child to them. They had difficulty conceiving but adopted a stray cat and lived like family, but eventually decided to get a divorce.

A romantic comedy drama filled with laughter and emotion, Sleeping Doctor follows Hong Gyeong, a promising psychiatrist who cannot cure her own illness, and Nam Ji O, a pay doctor known as the “Hwa-ta” of the hospital world for his exceptional memory.

After experiencing sexual violence, Hong Gyeong believes she has overcome her trauma and opens the private clinic she has long dreamed of. However, she is unable to treat patients due to narcolepsy, which causes her to fall asleep whenever she stands before them. As she struggles to keep her clinic running, she meets Nam Ji O, a “munchkin” doctor who has mastered medical knowledge across all departments.

Together, they fight to survive the neighborhood clinic scene as self-employed doctors, healing each other and gradually stepping out of the trauma that resurfaces along the way, while growing into love.
Oh Dal Nim is falsely accused of murder. She decides to take revenge on those responsible for her misery.

A brilliant surgeon with a hidden, vile alter ego fights to keep her humanity intact—until a relentless detective, tied to her past and her creation, falls in love with the very monster he’s sworn to stop. 

Jenny is a brilliant surgeon—admired, respected, seemingly flawless. But hidden beneath her calm exterior is “M”: a violent alter ego who surfaces whenever Jenny loses control. To keep M contained, she depends on a strict regimen of pills. If she falters, M awakens—stalking predators and leaving a trail of brutal murders across the city. Her world shifts when old acquaintances mistake her for Ma Ri, a woman who vanished a decade ago. Among them is Detective Ji Seok, who is shaken to discover Jenny’s uncanny resemblance to the woman he once loved— and lost. The façade cracks when an abused child is rushed into Jenny’s ER. Seeing the child’s injuries triggers "M", and soon the…

An omnibus drama that tells the story of people who earn ‘lost time’ just before dying. The characters tackle the difficult question, “If there is something you could do right before you die, what would you do?”

A romantic comedy about the misunderstandings and mishaps that occur when a student on the job hunt accidentally loses her phone. Choi Soo Yeon is a spirited college student who lives with her uncle after her parents passed away in a car accident when she was young. Kye Han Sol is a charming café owner who is aloof but well-mannered, while Yoo In Hae is a musical diva who dotes on Choi Soo Yeon as if she were her own daughter.
Ghost Vros tells the story of a startup company that exorcises ghosts with VR equipment. Ghost Vros employees will look for ghosts with VR equipment and help vengeful ghosts through counseling.

A fateful romance about Kim Byeol, a fatalist who is pessimistic about her fate and devoted herself to fortune telling, finding herself in front of two Woo Joos whose names are the same as her future husband's.

In a world where mythical beings secretly coexist with humans, the Embassy of Foreign Beings in Korea quietly oversees the lives of supernatural residents, from haetae and mermaids to nine-tailed foxes.

When former Asian Games archery gold medalist Ko Mi U is unexpectedly assigned as the embassy's first human rookie diplomat, she finds herself working alongside Cha Yeon, the mysterious ambassador who is secretly a dragon. Having spent more than a thousand years bound to this land, Cha Yeon's lonely, unchanging existence is upended by Mi U’s arrival, leading to an enchanting romance that bridges the worlds of humans and mythical beings.
This is a comic human drama about Bong Gil who is forty, single and dying to move to Seoul and away from his 90-year-old father who's been making Pyeongyang Naengmyun for the past 70, lonely years.
Ji Yeon, whose life was ruined by false rumors, sets out to get revenge on her used-to-be best friend, Yu Mi.

When an unknown virus begins to spread across the globe, an average college student, by the name of Mina, takes it upon herself to find a way to stop it, before it destroys the world. Traveling back in time, to the place where she believes the virus first made its appearance, Mina appears directly in front of the painfully timid Kim Yo Han.

Informing Yo Han that she’s here from the future to prevent a viral apocalypse, Yo Han can’t decide if the woman standing before him is telling the truth, or just trying to play some sick prank. Realizing Yo Han doesn’t believe her, Mina explains her situation further and admits that her research has led her to this exact moment for one very simple reason: As the carrier of the virus, Yo Han is the reason the world is about to end.
A 72-second romance drama series about dating and relationship that follows the lives of four different couples.
A story focused around a woman who only has a limited amount of time left. The story unfolds as she unexpectedly meets her old love.

It is the love triangle romance that takes place when Ye Jin goes to search for her long-time online friend named "Sweet Brick". She does not know if he is a member of her craftwork class named No Woon or the man she often meets by chance named Cha Ian.

~~ Partially adapted from the webtoon "Sometoon x OH MY GIRL" (썸툰 x 오마이걸) by Mohito Mohikan (모히또모히칸).
A woman who used to be as innocent as a white swan, turns into a black one to avenge her father and bring back her child that was taken from her.

Tells the story of Heo Seol Hui, a woman from the Joseon era who loses everything after her family is destroyed. She then returns to her 20-year-old past and struggles fiercely as she sharpens her blade of revenge.

Asked by a friend to teach his sister, he was taken aback when she falls in love with him and confess her love, Teacher, would you date me? 
How will he reject her confession, especially when she doesn't know how to give up and keep trying to win his heart?
dramas.t: Teacher, Would You Like to Date Me?

dramas.syn: A slice-of-life office drama about people who don't want to go to work that will resonate with everyday office workers.

Kim Cheong Ha, the greatest master swordswoman and Queen of the Joseon Dynasty, meets a tragic end due to palace political intrigue. She suddenly awakens centuries later in the body of Park Da Jin, a quiet high school student who is a frequent victim of school violence. 

Combining her royal dignity with elite martial arts skills, Cheong Ha sets out to turn the tables on the bullies of Juwon High, delivering a cathartic story of revenge while navigating modern teenage life and finding an unexpected romance that connects her past and present.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “High School Queen" (여고생왕후) written by Keuriti (크리티) and illustrated by Ne Hae (네해).

Set in a world where AI has infiltrated human dreams, creating a system that punishes criminals by trapping them in inescapable nightmares. When offenders evade the law, they are instead subjected to this technology, which manipulates the subconscious and turns fear into a tool of justice.

Detective Kim Tae I of the Violent Crimes Unit at Nambu Police Station, known for his sharp instincts and relentless pursuit of the truth, becomes entangled in a series of cases linked to this dream-based punishment system. As he investigates, he uncovers a larger conspiracy behind the AI technology, confronting a reality where human fear and desire are weaponized.

Working alongside him is Detective Jang Gyu Eun, a shy and introverted victim specialist haunted by the trauma of a tragic childhood accident. Driven by a need for vengeance, she hides a dark role within the system—transforming in the…

Stories about a young girl, Jin Joo, who is trying to find her perfect boyfriend, but all her relationships end the same way, quarrels and partings. These several stories will be told by two persons, the girl herself and her boyfriends, and how they see the same situation in different ways. Will Jin Joo be able to sort out his relationship?

An ordinary single woman who enjoys cooking and dining alone in the evenings, Ra Yeo Joo is an editor at a publishing house where she’s worked for the past ten years, while Lee Jae Yoon works in marketing at the same company. Their relationship is sometimes friendly, sometimes flirty, and sometimes competitive. They have different approaches to food: while she finds healing in food and drink, his goal in life is to live lean and long, until he discovers new pleasures and changes because of her.

~~ Adapted from the manga series "Wakakozake" (ワカコ酒) by Shinkyu Chie (新久千映).

The 3rd season of the popular web drama First Love Story introduces new main characters who belong to the university club called [CIRCLE ODDEYE]. 

This college romance drama features the members of the girl group "LOOΠΔ"

Hae Jin is 36-years-old. She is married to Jin Sang, who is 6 years younger than her, and they have a daughter Yoo Ri. Hae Jin runs a restaurant that she took over from her father-in-law. She supported her husband Jin Sang while he studied to enter a university. Because of Hae Jin, Jin Sang is now attending a prestigious university, but he has an affair with Joo Ri. She is the young daughter of a rich family. Hae Jin becomes aware of her husband's affair, but she doesn't want a divorce. Meanwhile, Dae Gu appears in front of Hae Jin. Dae Gu is a drama series writer. He was once in demand for his screenwriting, but his popularity has waned. His marriage life is not doing well either.

After an unjust dismissal, Jae Hun becomes a designated driver just to survive. One night, a drunk and powerful executive named Jun Hyeok turns him into a target — and a dependency. Trapped in a toxic cycle of power, violence, and emotional control, Jae Hun searches for the dignity and humanity he's lost.

Shin Jo Hee grew up without being loved by her mother. She is easily excited about trivial things, sometimes aggressive and spontaneous. People around her worry about her because of her bipolar disorder, but Shin Jo Hee does not intend to treat her disorder and thinks that it was caused by her mother.

Jin Woo Hyuk  is suffering from depression. He keeps feeling that he is trash. On the day he is diagnosed with depression, he meets Shin Jo Hee at the hospital and faces an unexpected change in his life.

"Why do I need to choose and give up between work, love, and friend?"

The story is about the romance of an office couple Seol and Jung Woo, and Seol's childhood friend Tae Hwan, who enters the company KOGAS.

"Sometoon 2021" depicts the life of youths through high school and college, incorporating scenarios such as blind dates, friendships, first and past loves, and more.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Sometoon" (썸툰) by Mohito Mohikan (모히또모히칸).
The drama tells stories about wedding planning with a great deal of details that nobody has told you so far.
dramas.t: The Birth of a Married Woman

dramas.syn:
The kiss of that day ruined everything.

This story begins with a sudden kiss that is to show what four men and women want when they want to say goodbye to each other! This is a complicated, bitter-sweet fantasy love story of four people who come together to experience real love.

The series is a sequel to Moment, Studio Lululala’s representative digital drama series. The emotions men and women often feel when they’re on a date will be described in an advanced format with refreshing characters. There is a couple who have gotten bored with each other. And there is another couple who broke up after hurting each other.

Four different young men and women come together to resolve the complicated problems of their love affairs. A couple who dream of starting a new love and another couple who dreams of having a perfect farewell ceremony. Will they be able to reach the end of the story they…

Jung Si Yeon is just your average high school student. Sweet and spunky, she spends her carefree days hanging out with her best friend, Yoon Hee, and crushing on the new transfer student, Sung Hyun.
When she finds out Sung Hyun was a drummer in a band, she tells him she’s in a band as well, in a desperate attempt to impress him. Guilt-ridden by her hasty actions, Si Yeon quickly becomes terrified she’ll be caught in a messy lie. To make things right, Si Yeon quickly assembles a group of classmates to form an actual band. Together with Lee So Yeon, the school’s resident delinquent and musical genius, Go Yu Na, an honor student with a magical voice, Yoon Hee, and Sung Hyun, Si Yeon forms the band, “Do Dream”.
When a school band contest offers a 5 million won prize, the band members agree, winning should be their number one goal. But dreams don’t come true, just because you want them to…

Kim Moo Young, Heo Won Ho and Baek Ji Soo have been friends since high school. Now in their 30s, each of them is struggling in their own way. Moo Young works at a dead end job in a convenience store. Won Ho gave up his dream of writing music to work in an advertising agency. Meanwhile, Ji Soo is an aspiring movie director. Moo Young had a crush on Woori in high school.

One day, Moo Young's friends, who have no concept of personal space, decide that they should go on a road trip together. Unbeknownst to his friends, Moo Young who is struggling with depression has been planning to commit suicide.

The fantasy romance comedy Web-drama depicts stories happening among four characters: Yoo Ri, a vampire with antibody for Acquired Immune Deficit Disorder, her younger sister 'Jo In', a superstar Soo Jeong, who is also a vampire and looking for Yoo Ri, and a genius film director.
A story about a breathtaking and thrilling office romance between Lee Eun Jung, who lives with a friend from her childhood, and Jung Jae Hoon, her old friend and team leader at Eun Jung's workplace.

A coming-of-age journey of a young woman breaking free from the illusions of first love. Blending revenge, personal growth, friendship, family, and romance, it tells the story of Gong Mi Rae, who may be clumsy in love but is more sincere than anyone else. Through the pain of real-life relationships, she discovers not only the challenges of love but also the deeper love for herself.

An omnibus web series about four individuals filled with regret who are able to order delivery from a mysterious new restaurant called "Your Most Beautiful Days." The order allows them to relive their past or see their future.

Lee Ha-Jin and Cha Do-Yoon were deeply in love and planned to marry, but, because of circumstances standing in their way, she broke up with him cruelly. Eight years later the two of them meet again. Ha Jin has "erased" memories of her first love and is now enthusiastic about cooking. On the contrary, Do Yoon is still trapped in the past, full of vengeance and hatred toward her. 
To complicate matters, enter Jeong Woo, a good man with ulterior motives, and Min Hee, an evil woman who will do anything to stay on top and in her mother's graces
In 2010, a third-year high school girl who always ranked first in her class encounters a delinquent male student and faces her dreams and love.
dramas.t: Love Track: When We Were Wired

dramas.syn: Set between the prestigious Jinwol Boys’ High School and Jinwol Girls’ High School, two rival schools separated by a single wall, the story follows two student council presidents who refuse to lose to each other. Under the strict school rule that students caught dating will be expelled, the 19-year-old students find themselves facing their first loves while caught between fierce competition and growing romantic feelings.

A love story of a woman in her 20s who looks back on her different relationships with five men and sets out to find the answer to their relationship. Their journey to find the meaning of love and romance takes place at the beautiful tourist destinations in 7 regions including Gangwon-do, Jeollabuk-do, Jeju-do, Chungcheongbuk-do, Mokpo-si, Yeosu-si, and Jeonju-si.

Four women are ready to take their relationships to the next level and prepare to move in with their boyfriends. The only problem is, they’re all dating the same man- and come moving day, he’s nowhere to be found! Meet Sweet Beauty, Sexy Eater, Innocent Drinker, and Loyal Cry Baby, four vivacious fitness trainers now hell-bent on revenge against the man who stole their money and trust in the opposite sex.
Based on the real-life figure Park Mi Ok, Korea’s first female detective.

Ha Ri goes to a forest house to hang out with her friends. Ha Ri then meets a tarot card reader who  says she's fated to end up with a one-sided love. Plus, who's that mysterious girl calling Kang Lim "oppa"?

A fantasy drama depicting the magical story of Jeoncheondang, a mysterious candy store where the dark and mysterious owner, Hong Ja, sells wishes-granting sweets and the people who visit it.

~~ Adapted from the novel series "Fushigi Dagashiya Zenitendo" (ふしぎ駄菓子屋 銭天堂) written by Reiko Hiroshima (廣嶋玲子) and illustrated by jyajya (ジャジャ).
dramas.t: The Mysterious Candy Store Jun Chun Dang

dramas.syn: “Oh! Dear Half-Basement Goddesses” will tell the story of four Greek goddesses who come to Korea to spread love and peace. However, they are faced with the reality of high rent and living costs in Seoul. Putting their grandiose dreams aside, they hide their true identities and live together in a half-basement apartment.

It tells the bewitching story of a man and woman who claim to be “untempted at forty” but end up falling for each other. Having reached 40 without truly experiencing the flavor of life or love, their dormant hearts are unexpectedly reignited. A star anchor struggling with early-onset male menopause teams up with his former rival, a scrappy writer, to save a last-place-rated TV program, only to revive their long-forgotten romantic spark in the process.

Na I Jun, a star news anchor at a broadcasting station. Raised without hardship in an ordinary middle-class family, he earned a perfect score on the college entrance exam and became the youngest anchor in the network’s history. However, at 40, he suffers from early-onset male menopause, causing his self-esteem to plummet.

Seo Hae Yun is a writer for the news division. Having worked at various broadcasting stations for over a decade,…
A youth romance about a couple searching for the owner of a graffiti painting.

Lee Jin Sook is a speaker on family happiness. However, she has a sad past. Years ago, she was kicked out of the house by her mother-in-law and was forced to be separated from her newborn daughter. She remarried, and when her second husband died 5 years later, she brought up her two young stepdaughters like her own. She was against the marriage when her youngest stepdaughter Oh Yeong Chae wanted to marry Kim Hyeon Tae, a rookie boxer and an orphan, but she relented. When Yeong Chae, who was involved in a hit-and-run accident, died after giving birth to a son, Jin Sook blamed and hated her son-in-law.
After Yeong Chae's death, Hyeon Tae and his son stayed together with Jin Sook and treated her like his mother. When she saw how Hyeon Tae took care of his son, her attitude towards him changed. Now she treats Hyeon Tae like her real son.
One day, Hyeon Tae falls in love with a woman named…

Desperate times call for desperate measures and for one mom, that means bagging a rich man to make her kids happy. Pil Jeong is a single, divorced mom of two who swore that she’ll never get married again. Her children, on the other hand, have other plans in store. They beg her to find and marry a rich man as a means of securing their family’s future and a hilarious family expansion project ensues.

Min Sa Rin has adapted herself to the role of a daughter-in-law and her life is going relatively smoothly. She gets involved in an unexpected case.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Myeoneuragi" (며느라기) by Su Sin Ji (수신지).

A romantic comedy about Ma Ji Yong, a powerful hedge fund manager at the top of the financial food chain, and Cho U Ri, a contract veterinarian working at a zoo he acquires. As the wealthy investor and the veterinarian become entangled, their employer–employee relationship is unexpectedly turned upside down, leading to a battle of wills that gradually blossoms into romance.
A comical beauty fantasy drama about the soul of a mother and her daughter exchange after applying mysterious cosmetics.
It is based on the concept of "What if I could be the main character of a ruined film I made?''. It is a work about meeting people and falling in love.

The modern version of the story of Shim Chung Yi, a woman who sees the world in various colors and meets a pianist who sees the world only in black and white and finds out the secret to her lost father.

So Jin was Yoo Geon's childhood friend and first love. They meet again as she becomes one of his teachers in high school. After he suddenly dies, Yoo Geon is given a second chance in the form of thirty hours during which he finds the meaning of love.
A story about an ordinary high school girl who finds true love after receiving a phone call from herself 10 years in the future.

A romantic comedy that depicts a woman's crazy solo project where four men get entangled in her confession.

Kim Se Ra is a webtoon PD who is more accustomed to finding love in 2D than in reality. Kim Se Ra becomes an 'unintentional femme fatale' when she makes a sudden confession to her unrequited love interest who comes to her as a variable in her life, and ends up getting three other men.

Lee Sun Gyu is webtoon writer who is suddenly confronted with a confession by Se Ra. Lee Sun Gyu has an innocent appearance and good manners, but he is a difficult man who neither crosses the line he has drawn nor allows anyone to cross it. However, he has a devilish charm that arouses even more curiosity because of that.

Park Hyeon U is a job seeker who seems easygoing at first glance but harbors realistic pain and is Se Ra's long-time boyfriend. He is a character who gradually realizes his own…

Han Ji Sub, a man who’s never felt happy in his life, almost escapes his miserable life against all odds, thanks to his iron will and hard work. However, when his mother’s mistake makes all his attempts come to naught, he’s devastated. Still, he has love of Seo Ra, a warmhearted girl whose life goal is to help others. As their fate becomes intertwined with that of Hae Rim, who gained love at the expense of her sister, and of Jae Wook, whose greed knows no end, each person’s secrets and hidden desires come afloat.

Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team 'Big Pandas', which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae' coaching a professional basketball team.

Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname 'Maeng Gong Extermination Group'. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong.

With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.
'Love Teenager' is a growing romance story dealing with friendship, love, and empathy among teenagers.

Min Hwa Yeong, the chief prosecutor of Special Investigation Division 1 at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors’ Office, dedicated her life to justice after her mother’s suspicious death drove her to seek the truth. Rising through relentless determination despite powerful opposition and external pressures, she earns a place in one of the prosecution’s most influential units and launches an investigation into a vast network of corruption and hidden power. But just as she closes in on the truth, her world is shattered when her husband is named the prime suspect in a murder case.
This special contains behind the scene footage, NGs and commentary of the cast

Yeon U, the successor of the Sipgang Clan, the largest gang violence group in Korea, sneaks into a high school after dressing up as a man to remove the successor of the rival gang, according to her father's orders. But... she definitely believed that she could kill him until she fell in love with him!
dramas.t: Gang Girl Goes to Boys High School

dramas.syn: Han Jung Woo is an aspiring singer-songwriter with a moist sensibility unlike his tough personality and is more serious about music than anyone else but is often hit by reality day by day for working part-time at a chicken feet restaurant. Meanwhile, Yu Chae Rin is an influencer that's considered a national goddess who lives a happy life only through social media.

An accident has changed five men and women’s fates. Unlike conventional love stories with lovely memories and anecdotes, their love is judged and frowned upon. Despite the criticisms on them, they can’t stop themselves from desperately loving each other. Bad Love is a sad love drama that portrays true love that hurts.

Si Woo, the female lead, suddenly gains superpowers one day: ‘if you share the Subway menu, you can hear the person’s heart’. The title of the work was created by combining the English word ‘Hear’ and Subway’s ‘Way’ to contain the same content.

It is about two country girls with different dreams. There is a girl from the countryside named Dan Yi. She wants to support rural communities. And, there's Sam Wol who is happy to leave her hometown and has a dream of becoming someone like Cinderella. With two different dreams, they both move over to Seoul. How would their life change in the near future?

Under the overall theme of unrequited love and having a crush on someone unattainable, the drama tells stories of various happenings that can arise in such relationships. The stories are told from the perspectives of both men and women as if they were written from an omniscient point-of-view, which allows viewers to sympathize with both sides and adds another layer to seemingly ordinary incidents between men and women.

There are a lot of misunderstandings for a young man dedicated to his job. Tae Jung is a lingerie designer who works for a large company. In his daily research on female undergarments, he is often mistaken for a pervert.
Arum is also a lingerie designer who runs her own small online company from her bedroom.
With numerous run-ins and misunderstandings with each other, will Tae Jung and Arum bond over their mutual passion about women’s lingerie?
A 10 billion won insurance murder case causes Oh Ha Naui to lose everything. She sets out to take revenge upon Chun Mi Ja who caused her misfortune.
A lethal but innocent love story of a man who only pursued success for his family towards a woman who lost everything after finding her husband's rich parents.

Na Yeong Ja, an ordinary department store clerk, is entangled in a love triangle with the scion of a department store fortune and a top executive at the same department store. This TV series is like a Cinderella fairytale story but without a passive heroine who waits for a prince to bring her a glass shoe. Instead, the heroine of this show reaches her goal by proactively seizing opportunities and working hard to also find love in her personal life.

It captures the story of Super Junior's birth and debut, from the intense trainee days through the beginning of the large project group 'Super Junior 05' that has never been seen before to today.

In addition, the members of Super Junior, who are heading towards the 20th anniversary of their debut, will honestly reveal their true and inner feelings that they have never brought out to the world, revealing their days of growing up together in joy, pain, happiness, and despair.

In particular, through the growth story of Super Junior, the global representative of Korean idols, both in name and reality, you can get a glimpse of the K-Pop industry.
dramas.t: Super Junior: The Last Man Standing

dramas.syn: The most fragrant of all perfumes in the world is said to be made from roses that grow in a deep, treacherous mountain in the Balkans and plucked during the coldest nights. Beautiful pearls are painfully taken from clams by cracking them open. Han Seung Ri finds her life spiraling out of control after her dad's death that ruins the family finances. The man she loved betrays her and she has a miscarriage not too long afterward. After hitting rock bottom, she climbs out of her misery to take over the family business that her dad ran and marches forward to reach her dreams. Hopeful that tomorrow will be better than yesterday, she endures the pain and anguish to reach an outcome that is sweeter due to the ordeal she had to overcome to attain it.

Oh Dan-Byul lost her parents due to her own mistake. She marries Joon-Young, but her husband passes away. Meanwhile, her mother-in-law, Ho-Duk, divorces because of her husband's infidelity and her sister-in-law, Se-Sil, returns to South Korea after divorcing her Italian husband. Now, these three women live together while overcoming their own personal problems and becoming important to each other.

Oh Min Joo, a rookie employee of an office who dreams of quitting her job. She experiences the ups and downs one goes through in the workplace and represents the sympathy of the 20s-30s age working group.
This drama will show the daily life, friendship and love of youth who love K-League and soccer.

The story of Ma Ri, a young woman who often daydreams imagining her romantic love story. Especially when she has a crush on Ki Yung, a student majoring in veterinary medicine. Ma Ri has a crush on Ki Yung because she often stops by the bookstore where he works. Not alone, Ma Ri is always accompanied by her two friends, Yoon Hee and Su Ho. Yoon Hee is a friend she met in college while Su Ho is her friend since high school. It turns out that Su Ho is the same as Mari. He also often daydreams and imagines he can date Ma Ri.

It tells the story of No Jun Su, who is running a coffee shop. One day, he witnessed the car accident of Yoo Nam H,ui for whom he has a one-sided love. To save her from the coma, he decided to join the yet-to-be-verified medical project called “In Your Dream”. 

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "In Your Dream" (인 유어 드림) written by Kim Kwang Min (김광민) and illustrated by Do Rang (도랑).

dramas.nt: KBS 드라마 스페셜 2022 - 낯선 계절에 만나
dramas.syn: It tells the story of COVID-19 confirmed patients in 2020 who enter a residential treatment center, communicating through windows and comforting each other during unfamiliar and fearful quarantine times.
A drama set in Dong-gu, Busan, about young people chasing romance, not money.
Side story and follow up of popular web drama "Crushes- Special Edition" - This side story follows through the married lives of couple Park Sung Woo & Kim Su In.

A drama centered around the district of Gangnam and Seo Cho Hee, a woman who struggles to improve the quality of life with a house. It has a realistic family message that happiness is not about the house but about the family that lives in it.
