A young man and a woman who have become ghosts due to their mistakes from their previous lives go out on an interesting mission for a chance to be reincarnated after paying the price.
A short offbeat romance drama about  dating and relationships.

Tells the story of a long-term couple—both with celebrity-level visuals and high incomes—who have been dating for nine years and are about to get married. One day, they decide to give each other a “cheating prevention vaccine.” Wanting to eliminate any lingering regrets before marriage, they propose meeting other partners and take a “break time.”

After being falsely accused of murder, Ko Eun Seol loses everything and has her life stolen from her. Determined to clear her name, reclaim her future, and take revenge on those responsible, she embarks on a relentless quest to expose the truth behind the false accusation that ruined her life.

Standing in her way is Cho Mi Ran. She comes across as warm and devoted, but that's just the surface. Underneath, she's spent years quietly taking what isn't hers, willing to steal someone else's happiness and future if it gets her closer to what she wants. She's built her entire life on lies, and she's not going to let Eun Seol tear it down.

As Eun Seol digs deeper, she crosses paths again with Cha Seok Jin, her first love, and a decade-old history neither of them has fully left behind. Old wounds resurface, long-hidden secrets begin to unravel, and she finds herself in conflict with Kang Hae…
Jin Nam Joo gets dumped by her boyfriend, whom she believed was fate, on the first day of the new year. Her fortune-telling dad predicts that three men of destiny will appear before his daughter.

Gye Sook Ja is a recruiting team leader of an enormous game company. She is gifted with extraordinary memories and computation abilities, but she tries to quantify everything in the world and is regarded as “cold-blooded” among the people around her.

Lee Hae Joon is a successful lawyer working with international children’s rights. He tries to help Gye Sook Ja overcome the pain and trauma of her past.
Cast members of "18 Again" ask each other extreme balance questions and play with a lie detector for a healing time.
dramas.t: 18 Again｜A Make-up Class in Serim High

dramas.syn: Mini beauty drama.

For a long time, a mother has sacrificed herself to raise her four children but these children are only interested in her fortune and their possible inheritance. Stung by their betrayal and unacceptable behavior, she is determined to live the rest of her life to the fullest and be selfish for a change. This TV series will revolve around family values with themes of generational conflict and reconciliation. The revenge of a mother on her grownup children begins now!

"The blue sea" is an action drama that tells the story of a mysterious young man who lost his memory. Jo Eun Hee is a female soldier in the navy who works with Sung Ki Soo to carry out special missions under UDU (Underwater Demolitions Unit) Sung Ki Soo is a navy lieutenant who is also a professor at the non-commissioned officer department who is the first to see through the identity of the young man who lost is memory.
Han U Jeong is a bright, happy person. After she's betrayed by her best friend, Sin Hwa Gyeong, her life is ruined. However, despite all this, she continues pursuing her dreams and never loses hope!

Se Yeong works as a secretary to the head of the fashion brand "Radical." Her boss, Su Hyeon, torments her harshly, but she always manages to complete her tasks with determination. Then one day, the silver-spoon brat Su Hyeon confesses, "You're the first woman I've ever fallen for!"
"I find you very strange, Director."

As a butterfly effect of this rejection, a villain moves in next door to Se Yeong.  Se Yeong, now having her neighbor as her boss, tries hard to avoid Su Hyeon, but his pursuit continues relentlessly. While trying to evade Su Hyeon's affections, Se Yeong gradually starts to feel drawn to him. The boss who seemed like a villain begins to help Se Yeong and wins her heart, and Su Hyeon also triumphs in an internal company competition with Se Yeong's help.

Their feelings grow alongside the company's success. However, Do Hyeon watches them with an indecipherable gaze, and…

“Irish Uppercut” show refreshing chemistry between the two leads with a gorgeous Jeju Island backdrop. Bora is playing an adorable grim reaper by the name of Do Hye Na.  Do Hye Na has nothing going for her in this world, but when she passes away she meets a cook named Woo Shi Hyung, played by Kim Ji Suk, in the afterlife and they experience many episodes together in a pub called “Irish Uppercut.”
About love stories between men and women in their 20s and 30s with functions of various SNS features such as DMs, stories, comments, likes, and hashtags.

The story centers on Tae Jun Seop, the grandson of TK Group chairman Tae Si Hwan and a third-generation chaebol known as an outwardly flawless, perfect man within his elite family. Beneath his composed exterior, he carries a cold inner side and a complicated family background.

His life changes when he meets Yeon U Gyeong, a copywriter who becomes entangled with him as she appears in his world. As their relationship develops, the two are drawn into a succession battle within the conglomerate, where romance and corporate power struggles intersect.

~~ Adapted from the web novel “A Casual Lie" (태연한 거짓말) by Kim Eon Hui (김언희).
The popular and new characters will be creating a love story that's as real as it gets.
Tells the story of a woman and a man who can't forget their first love. The two leads' time stop every time it's 1:11, and they think about the memories of their first love.

When her parents disapprove of her boyfriend, Seo Gyung decides to elope with him to America and only when she becomes a mother herself does she understand her parents and how important family is. During her darkest hours, her family was there for her. When she is caught in a love triangle with two suitors, she finds her true self through love, courage and emotional healing.
Soo Yeon will take her college entrance exam soon. She is bad at math so her mother hires a teacher to prepare her for college entrance exam.

The drama will be a telling of historical events with the scholar as the central character. Ryu Seong Ryong was an official who served during King Seon Jo’s reign in the late 16th century. He was a brilliant Confucian scholar who was put in charge of military operations during the Imjin War, and greatly influenced Admiral Lee Soon Shin. The story starts before the Imjin War begins and will follow the characters all the way through the Battle of Noryang, and the death of Lee Soon Shin.
dramas.t: The Jingbirok: A Memoir of Imjin War

dramas.syn: A pre-produced web-drama about a man who can communicate with animals. He breaks up with his girlfriend and therefore their animal friends, a dog and a monkey, must also break up. The animals endeavor to bring their masters back together.
A romantic comedy drama about a drama writer wannabe Park Ji Ho who acts as a man and becomes an expert in relationship advice and transforms loser Oh Geun Baek into a winner.

A woman begins to think of herself as damaged  goods on the love market after her long-time boyfriend dumps her. A new love story begins when she meets the man who helps her realize the value of second-hand goods.
A sitcom that takes place in "Amazing", a magical club in a university with members that have superpowers.

A healing drama about the reset of the lives of people who stand up again in a moment of despair. A single woman fighting cancer and a penniless single father meet and depict a healing romance for both sides to heal each other's wounds.

A divorced couple unexpectedly finds themselves sharing the same living space, forcing them to confront the realities of both their failed marriage and their new lives apart. Set against the backdrop of a luxury hotel's VIP Club Lounge, the story follows people who once loved deeply but gradually lost sight of themselves and each other. Through humor, friendship, and second chances, they begin a journey of rediscovering love, identity, and the possibility of new beginnings.

A romance drama set in a restaurant that opens only on Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays. The story follows Chef Kim Dong Uk and Cha Eun Su, who reunite with a love they once lost, returning to the place where it all began. They have a deep, longstanding connection to the restaurant. As their lives intersect within the limited days the restaurant operates, a romance gradually unfolds, shaped by shared time, memories, and the unique space that brings them together.

"Yeah, we're thirty."

Turning thirty is an age when we mistakenly believe we are somewhat prepared, even if we haven't perfectly figured out life, love, or finding ourselves. While navigating the confines of this illusion, we meet people, form relationships, experience various emotions, learn about life and finally become an adult.

Through Seo Eun, the drama depicts how we reflect upon ourselves, overcome unexpected obstacles in life, and grow through relationships. The story features sensory visuals and contemplative narration.

Do Eun Soo is a single woman in her 30s who lives a mundane predictable life working as an office worker, trying to get through tough times calmly with all the office survival skills she learnt through the years.  She deals with the challenges in her work by finding comfort with delicious food.

With the arrival of handsome new co-worker Lee Ji Yong and long-time colleague Yoo Woong Jae's sudden change of demeanor towards her, Eun Soo soon finds herself in an office love triangle.
A mystery medical drama about forensic scientists uncovering the truth behind suspicious and unnatural deaths.

"All Love in the World" is a realistic yet fresh and comic depiction of the romance of various young couples nowadays. The webdrama is divided into three seasons, each one is focused on one couple with their own problems.

Season 1 follows the story of a couple who started as a college campus couple but who encounters problems because of their age difference.
dramas.t: All the Love in the World

dramas.syn: Park Bo Hyun transfers to a school in the country?! But this school is… unusual.

Yoon Ye Eun's husband of 7 years has a profitable business and they move into a new house. Then, she finds out about his affair. Her sister Yoon Sang Eun is in debt and runs a piano institute. She meets someone through a matchmaking agency and considers entering a contract marriage to pay off her debts.
The coming-of-age sitcom depicts the struggles and adventures by a single lady, Yoo Mi, who tries to find her own happiness and what she really loves.

In Season 2, the severe trauma team will respond to larger-scale disasters and more serious crises. Led by Baek Gang Hyeok, the medical staff will not only rescue patients caught between life and death but also confront the limitations of the medical system.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jungjeung Oesang Senteo: Goldeun Awo" (중증외상센터: 골든 아워) by Hansan iga (한산이가).
dramas.t: The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call Season 2

dramas.syn: There is one parent who stands out as an exception in the posh Gangnam neighborhood and her name is Bok Dang Ji. She moved to Gangnam and lives paycheck to paycheck and believes that she is blessed like Cinderella because the man she married was someone she had a crush on. Then she meets a prosecutor who has a privileged life and a lot in common with her. He was born poor but reached the wealthy elite class through sheer determination. His name is Han Jung Wook. But one day, they both find their lives spiraling downward. This show revolves around Bok Dan Ji, a Gangnam mom, and Han Jung Wook, who is rudely knocked off his perch as a member of the wealthy elite, whereupon they gradually develop a relationship and find true love.
A story about the love of men and women who reunited with the 'Login' dating app.

A kindergarten teacher’s life takes a completely unexpected turn.

Na Rae is a kindergarten teacher who suddenly develops the ability of a shaman fortuneteller while praying at a church one day. She gives up her life as a teacher and finds fame and wealth as a fortuneteller. But as time passes, her skills begin to fade. When Na Rae discovers a mysterious app called “T-Scope,” can she use it to regain her fortunetelling fame?

“Fortuneteller’s Secret Recipe” is a 2017 Viki Original web drama series that is the third season of the “Traces of the Hand” series. The three-season series, all starring Ryu Hwayoung in completely different lead roles, follows the first season, titled “Traces of the Hand,” and the second season, titled “Girl’s War.”

"The crazy reunion of friends who haven't seen each other for ten years".
Ten years later, a crazy reunion of petty neighbors took place, where we learn how our crazy boys have changed.
A fantasy romance about a woman who can see the death in people due to an accident and a psychiatrist who finds real happiness after a downfall in life.
Mini Drama starring Stray Kids members, Hyunjin and I.N, for Hanhwa Seoul Fireworks Festival 2018.

Bubble up tells the stories of young university students from two competing schools, who decide to open a joint youtube channel representing the student bodies of both universities. Kim Se Woon, a second year business student at Dae Han University. The character is known for his bright and generous personality, but he feels envy toward the more confident and straightforward On Ha Young.
A story of love and work following a part-timer and actress So Ri till the day she will become the "perfect celebrity"!
“Kim Is a Genius” is about the strange things that happen when a viral marketing company starts using a make-believe app.

A story that unfolds as the male and female leads from two families become entangled: one family has a mother who, facing death, is called “crazy” for the lengths she goes to for the children she will leave behind, and the other has a “crazy mom” who, driven solely by her own desires and greed, abandons and turns her back even on the daughter she gave birth to.

The story of a Korean cuisine chef, Yeo Moon Joon who runs a restaurant in Vietnam. The drama introduces various recipes that are as sweet as the romantic love story of the young and talented chef and his beautiful lady customer with incredibly sensitive palate.

Ji Hyun was proud to be the only employee who was good at playing office politics until her rival, Hye In, joined the company to work on a short-term project. Hye In outclasses Ji Hyun in every way, including physical beauty and track record. It's a matter of course that she steals the spotlight from Ji Hyun, especially the attention of Senior Direction Byun. 

Assistant Manager Park Seong Eun is glad to have Hye In in her team because there's finally someone who can drive Ji Hyun nuts. However, it looks like Hye In has feelings for her boyfriend Jin Ho?! As a result, Ji Hyun and Seong Eun form a new alliance to drive out the fox that has invaded their team.

Meanwhile, another couple, Sa Ra and Kyung Jun, faces their own crisis. It's because of the delivery man who frequently drops by the office. Kyung Jun, who is quick-witted, keeps a close eye on Sa Ra and the delivery man, who seems…
A family drama about a woman who is hurt by love, striving for small happiness and realizing the preciousness of family.

A time-slip stock romance that takes place when a scholar of the Joseon Dynasty, An Ta, meets Min Ji, an MZ generation office worker, and discovers his talent for stock investment that he did not know.
Yoo Ari and Ahn Do Jun are idol fans and best friends. They become friends with transfer student Jung Yu Hee who becomes a fan of trainee teacher Ahn Jae Hyun.
A story about unrefined 'savage' that any 20-year-old college student would have crossed paths with.

Feeling like the epitome of failure, recent college graduate Grace (Grace Subervi) drunkenly stumbles her way through New York City, making her way to, and eventually into, the Hudson River. Upon awakening, she finds herself in another world — or rather, another country: South Korea.
Her troubles only worsen when she literally bumps into Kyung Hwan, a wealthy boutique owner with little patience to spare. Through Kyung Hwan, she meets aspiring K-pop idol, David, where all three come to terms with what it means to pursue their dreams.
 
DramaFever’s first ever original drama series!
~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Namnam" (남남) by Jeong Young Ryong (정영룡).
The sweet and bitter campus life of those who want to protect love and friendship even in the stark college life, where romance is nowhere because of the cancellation of OT and MT begins!

A bromance drama between a Generation X retired agent and a Generation Z super ace, pursuing an insider who has been behind a criminal organization for over 25 years. The story of two men who work together as one finds a chance to be reborn as a hero, and the other a chance to fulfill his dream of becoming a field agent.

Kim Cheol Su, a retired black agent and car wash owner. While he may appear to be an ordinary man, hiding his lion's claws and living like a sheep, he is actually a legendary black agent of the National Intelligence Service, codenamed "Phoenix."

Ko Yo Han, a member of the National Intelligence Service's retired agent management team. While possessing exceptional abilities, his excessive self-confidence and autocratic behavior often lead to labeling him a "snobbery" and "servility." He's an anxious perfectionist consumed by a need for self-promotion and recognition.

An heiress, cursed to live a life of misfortune as an illegitimate child, finds herself entangled with a star host at a secret club in the affluent neighborhood of Cheongdam-dong.

Cheong Guk, a former taekwondo athlete and the ace host of a secret club called “Si Bel Homme” (meaning “Such a handsome man” in French), is known for his tall, athletic physique. He enters the nightlife world after his stepmother vanishes with his late father’s life insurance payout, leaving him to inherit substantial debt.

Together, they protect each other from dark forces and discover true love.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Night of Heaven" (천국의 밤) by Hwang Ui Geon (황의건).
A 19+ romantic office drama about a protagonist who was betrayed by her husband and best friend and starts a dangerous contract affair with her best friend's husband for revenge.

Set against the wave of democratization and cultural modernization that swept through South Korea in the early 1990s, the series centers on a middle-class family concealing a treasonous secret. Though appearing to be ordinary citizens to their friends, neighbors, and even their own children, Kim Myeong Jun—an elite North Korean spy who has been living in South Korea for over a decade while hiding his true identity—and Yun Hwa Gyeong, a North Korean spy who has settled in South Korea as his carefully disguised wife, are in fact operatives working to destabilize the South from within.

As the series unfolds, the pair are pulled between their allegiance to their homeland, their sense of self, and the bonds they have formed as a family, while Cha Gi Seok, a relentless counterintelligence detective and former violent crimes unit officer who moves in next door, edges ever closer to exposing…

A male engineering student gains supernatural powers after turning 25. As soon as his friends find out about his abilities, they start taking advantage of him to improve their personal careers and love lives.

A decade-long chronicle of love and separation shared by Jeong Hui and Hyeong Min. From their naive high school days through passionate college years to adulthood, the series tracks their 22 unique breakups, exploring what it means to truly love—and grow.

This is not an omnibus. The 22 stories are tightly interwoven, each breakup leading into the next like a domino effect. It captures the emotional compression of stand-alone dramas and the continuity of serialized storytelling.
dramas.t: 22 Ways to Say Goodbye with Grace

dramas.syn: Gong Soo Rae only love her husband, Seo Bong Gook since she met him in her teen-ages. She then learns that her husband is having an affair with Choi Yi Kyung. Meanwhile, Park Chan Woo will plays a man who supports her.

Strange things happen to influencer Han Da Bit from Anyeon University, starting with the nightmare that she has one day. Then one day, she sees Do Hee, a senior she runs into at school, and Da Bit feels a strange attraction. Da Bit, who follows her out of curiosity about Do Hee, enters a unique tarot shop.

A hyper-realistic comedy depicting the story of a 'military' recruit enlisting in a place where all kinds of people, from the good to the bad to the weird, gather.

~~ Adapted from the animation " New Recruit" (신병) by Jang Bbi Jju (장삐쭈).

It tells the story of Ko Dal Bun, a delicate, plant-like woman whose only life plan was to become a devoted wife and mother. Forced to survive outside her “greenhouse,” she takes an unplanned job at a suspicious company in order to regain custody of her young daughter, becoming entangled in unexpected events. The company claims to promote women’s participation in society, but it harbors something far more questionable. Having lived quietly and obediently as a dutiful daughter and submissive wife, Dal Bun discovers an unexpected talent—the ability to eliminate a person without leaving any sound or trace.
A web drama about a genius plastic surgeon and his ex-wife who run a beauty clinic. "Swan" is a Korea-China co-production.
A romantic comedy about a young woman who is full of justice and a young man who has no passion for life.

The father of Joo Dong, Joo Nam, and Joo Yeon plans to give all his accumulated fortune back to society, except for the three story house, whose price has skyrocketed. He promises to leave the house to the one who gets married first in 6 months among the siblings. But when their father, Mr. Jeong, makes this unexpected announcement, Joo Dong, Joo Nam, and Joo Yeon who are beyond their best age to get married, start their search for a partner. Joo Yeon, 29, who has chosen to stay single, starts to also actively look for a partner to inherit the house. She gets a chance to think about marriage and reflect on her past relationships in this delightful romantic drama.

Getting older does not necessarily mean getting more prosperous in life. For the single lady Je Gal Jae Yeong, dealing with love, career, friendship, and family relationship is still difficult. Moving to a new neighborhood, making friends with new weird people, getting a new job and encountering her boyfriend’s new girlfriend weren’t that easy. To make things worse, she suffers from a disease that developed newly. Let’s experience the solace of her daily warm meal that will comfort her living the tough life. She cooks with whatever may be available and feeds herself randomly.

Jae Min heads to Bali after learning his fiancée Yeong Ju traveled there. Unbeknownst to him, she’s meeting her ex, In Uk. Tensions rise as Jae Min grows suspicious of their relationship. Meanwhile, Su Jeong, a part-time worker, gets caught in the conflict, leading to a chain of unexpected events.

An upbeat family-oriented TV miniseries with a mishmash of different generations and different attitudes towards relationships. The difficulties that arise between mother and daughter mostly due to the men they are having a relationship with becomes the central plot that illustrates the challenges that single moms and divorcees face in today’s society. Their lives and the lives of the people they are connected to are depicted in a way that viewers can relate to through a fuzzy warm feeling called love.

Hwang Ju Eun and Ko Tae Hun lost their six-year-old daughter Hui Su in a car accident. Now they live their days unable to shake their grief. Tae Hun becomes unable to watch Ju Eun breaking down. At the suggestion of his friend and program developer Jun Beom, Tae Hun recreates their daughter in a Virtual Reality format. The family seemed to regain some happiness with the VF Hui Su. Ju Eun's unhealthy obsession leads to catastrophe.
dramas.t: Drama Special Season 12: TV Cinema - Hee Soo

dramas.syn: Set in a high school in Mokpo, this webdrama perfectly reproduces various cultures and youth sensibilities such as music, dramas, movies, and fashion at a time, letting viewers to empathise and think about their memories.
A web-drama depicting office romance that's full of mystery, secrets, and interns trying to navigate through work life.

Kang Tae Yang attempts to stick to his principles while dealing with corruption at the construction company where he works and the supervisory agency who benefits from the corruption.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Bones of Steel" (鉄の骨) by Ikeido Jun (池井戸潤).

A hilarious romance between neighbors and cousins ​​that depicts the story of an old bachelor and an old maid who have an outdated notion that men and women must get married after sleeping together and accidentally spending a night together after meeting each other, who are the complete opposites of their ideal types.

Lee Mu Gae is a capable bachelor who is a literary critic and editor-in-chief of a publishing company. He is a dutiful son, a top student, and takes great care of his younger sister, but because of his timid personality, he is not good at confessing his love, and his specialty is unrequited love. Do Do Hye is a spinster who is the head of a publishing company's design department. She, who is a master at playing alone, is a woman who believes that she is the perfect bride in terms of face, body, and ability. However, she also has a strange ability to block men who approach…

A woman in her 70s, wielding a gun of vengeance for her grandson, and the man who awakened her hunting instincts wage a desperate revenge against the criminal organization Chunghwa Group.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Granny" (할매) by Jae Hu (재후).
'Half-Fifty' is a comedy drama about youth and growth, and the series follows a group of 25-year-olds who end up in the world of YouTubers.
A black comedy about the daily lives of employees in an advertisement agency and their competitive working environment.  ~~ Based on writer Lee Hyeon Min's original webtoon.

Han Yu Hyeon becomes the youngest CEO of Hansung, a successful electronics company built on a toxic work culture, but nobody he cares about is there to celebrate with him. After a night of drinking and wondering if he could change the past, he wakes up the next morning 20 years younger than at the beginning of his career. Armed with the experience and insights that made him CEO, Yu Hyeon begins to revisit broken relationships and battle the enablers of Hansung’s cut-throat work environment. But he does not yet know how changing the past will affect his future...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "A Man’s Man" (상남자) written by Kim Tae Gung (김태궁).

Hye Joo, the fattest girl in her school, is living an actual hell. What she goes through on an everyday basis is real and painful. She is relentlessly bullied for her weight issues.

Her friend, Sabrina, a Muslim, is bullied for wearing a hijab and is forced to watch helplessly as Hye Joo is mocked and attacked by their fellow classmates.
Talks about the healing period of agricultural horticulture therapy. Oh Won Ye a horticultural therapist called Leon meets Shin Bo Eun a regional officer who is diligent in duty to give him land.

Where can there be a teenager without a story?
If I send a DM to IABC, the Broadcasting Department of Iyego,
IABC will take care of it!

You must see it before you see Part 5!?
The most fun way to enjoy Real:Time:Love Series!
Teen Love Story of Iye High Broadcasters [I:Love:DM]

"Pro, Teen" is an omnibus school-themed web-drama about students who choose vocational high school to chase their dreams where they are growing up by solving various concerns and difficulties.

Shin Ha Neul is a first grade student at Design Communication Department that has a huge passion in drawing.

~~ Produced by Korea Scholarship Foundation to improve awareness about vocational high schools.

Jenny works as a fashion designer and she is successful at her job. She has a very close relationship with her mother Soo Jin. Her mother wants Jenny to marry Man Soo, but Jenny does not like Man Soo and ignores him. Jenny happens to meet Eun Suk. They fall in love with each other at first sight. Eun Suk has a warm and quiet personality, but he believes in doing the right thing. He is from a wealthy family. They decide to get married, but Jenny's mother Soo Jin opposes their marriage.

The story depicts the intense coaching competition within the world of men’s professional baseball.

Hwang Jin Ho is a coach and acting head coach for the Stars. He began playing baseball in the fourth grade and was once selected for the national team, though he never had the chance to wear the national team uniform. He lived a second‑rate life as a player and a one‑and‑a‑half‑rate life as a coach, yet his reputation as a coach now far surpasses anything he achieved during his playing days.

Cho Dong Hui, the Stars’ pitching coach, is universally recognized as the team’s greatest legendary pitcher, having recorded 189 career wins. His impressive career includes two Olympic medals and serving as Korea’s starting pitcher in the WBC game against Japan. However, when he finds himself coaching alongside Hwang Jin Ho—whom he once considered inferior during their playing careers—the two…

Jang Geum, who has been demonstrating medical techniques alongside the common people and pioneering new medical practices. One day, due to a conspiracy to assassinate King Myeongjong, she enters the palace along with her favorite disciple Jae Hui...
dramas.t: The Righteous Woman, Dae Jang Geum

dramas.syn: Reflects on the meaning of a 'life friend', the real friend we need through the process of becoming a real friend beyond the prejudice of disability.

Seo Rin who was recognized for her directing skills abroad, returns to Korea and will be the director of a green drama "Natural Romance". She will also be reuniting with Soo Hyeok who has been with her for a long time, since they were young and on the set. Unlike before, Soo Hyeok is now a top actor. They spent their childhood together, and whenever Seo Rin sees Soo Hyeok who once confessed to her, she feels happy.
dramas.t: The Pure Memories of My Heart

dramas.syn:
Set in the picturesque town of Cheongdo, this story revolves around the lives of two high school students, Soo Ah and Soo Hyuk. Soo Ah temporarily moves to Cheongdo to help her mother with persimmon farming. While adjusting to the new environment, she encounters Soo Hyuk, a responsible and hardworking student who is determined to carry on his family's café business. Soo Hyuk also happens to be  Soo Ah's first love.

As Soo Ah and Soo Hyuk spend time together in Cheongdo, their friendship gradually blossoms into a deep bond.

Three friends arrive at a guesthouse for a getaway. Their purpose, however, is death. Just as they each hang themselves in separate rooms, “Death” appears and refuses to let them die. If they wish to leave this world, they must first complete a mission: find the culprit behind a guesthouse murder case in which six guests were killed.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Death" (사랑하는 죽음) by Ieon (이언).
~~ Release dates: Jul 4, 2026 (Festival | Film format) || Jul 30, 2026 (Online | Series format)

A human medical drama set in the pediatric surgery department of a university hospital on the brink of closure due to a population decline and resulting management crisis. The story follows dedicated doctors who take on a child’s first surgery, open the door to their future, and embrace the responsibility of becoming a child’s “first adult,” delivering a powerful and heartfelt message.

Hyun-Soo is a university student who is smart and bright, but has lived through a tragic past. Her father died in a motorcycle accident and her mother suffered brain damage in the accident. Hyun-Soo dates Yoon-Ho and they decide to marry. At first, his mother, Young-Ae, opposes their marriage, but relents. After their marriage, Yoon-Ho and his father get into an accident, his father dies and he goes missing. Unaware that Hyun-Soo is pregnant, her mother-in-law moves to another country without telling her. Years later, Hyun-Soo and Young-Ae meet again.

"Farmer's Academy" dealt with the leading characters as new students at South Korea's only national university dedicated to farm work. The second season will deal with them in their third year as they are approaching graduation and careers as farmers.

A mother lives her whole life loyally in the lowest of places for the daughter of hers who is embarassed about her mother. But one day, her mother disappears. The daughter has no mother to hug, to complain to or see. Then there's the authority who is hiding the truth about this accident...
dramas.t: The Return of Hwang Geum Bok!

dramas.syn: Cho Bong Hui's family falls into difficulties after the death of her father. She overcomes obstacles to become the best fashion designer in South Korea.

An anthology about 'disappearance'.

> Story 1 : "Friendly Police" (친절한 경찰) [Director: Lim Kyung Taek (임경택)]
The story is about Ah Rin, a novelist in her 20s who moves into a new neighborhood where she meets police officer Kim, the only one who believes in what she says as she's been sensing strange things happening in her house.

> Story 2 : "Follower" (팔로워) [Director: Park Seon Jae (박선재)]
The story of Yeon Hee, who appears to be having a happily married life but is actually experiencing domestic violence. Little by little, Yeon Hee begins to fall into danger when posts suggesting self-harm are posted on the SNS account that impersonates hers.

> Story 3 : "Supermodel" (수퍼모델) [Director: Yoo Young Sun (유영선)]
The story of Ji Eun, a supermodel who instantly becomes a murder suspect. When she receives a phone call, she leaves the living room and comes back to a brutally dead boyfriend. Ji…
A story of the push and pull of a middle-aged man and a chef trying to figure out why onion soup, the only comfort in his weary life, has been removed from the menu.
dramas.t: Love Track: Onion Soup after Hours

dramas.syn: When  you feel low, you must go to the meat and cook it all ... You can eat it ... when you want to! Then you can eat it with
dramas.t: A Special Meal of the Weirdo 'Nara'

dramas.syn: Lee Sarang is a part timer, who stays alone in an   apartment. One day new part timer, Son Hyun Woo comes to work with her. Coincidentally, a new neighbour moved in whose identity is unknown to Sarang. The plot is about how coincidence can lead to being your fate.

Oh Soon Nam is a teacher at a traditional Korean school called Jeokhyeonjae, where she nurtures students’ aspirations like a friend. But one day, Soon Nam’s life crumbled down with the sudden loss of Jeokhyeonjae and her daughter Joon Yeong. Soon Nam embarks on an investigation to punish the people behind her daughter’s death and finds that she must choose between revenge and the values she has lived by all her life. This TV show revolves around a female teacher at a traditional Korean school who is also married to the sole descendant of a head family clan that comes with heavy responsibilities. Then tragedy strikes her. However, in memory of her daughter, she transforms into a person that people admire for her strength and perseverance in the face of adversity.

"A Ticket To India" is a web drama based on a romantic comedy theme proving to be a delightful watch. The storyline of this light-hearted Korean web-drama will take you through a guest house which is themed in India and has rooms named like Ganges, Jaisalmer, and Delhi. The guest house gives a perfect vibe, almost making you feel like you are walking through the streets of India.

Han Seo Ha is a bright and cheerful girl in 3rd year of middle school. She dreams of entering Hanlim Multi Art School because she loves singing. But she’s always compared to her older sister Seo Jin.  Seo Jin is a sophomore in Practical Music department in Hanlim Multi Art School. She has an aura of a girl group center. She’s excellent at playing piano, but she isn’t as good as Seo Ha when it comes to singing. Cha Su Ho is a sophomore in Hanlim, his speciality is piano and vocals. He’s tall and good-looking. He has all female students attention, but he isn’t interested in any of them. Do Chae Ah is a sophomore in Hanlim. She receives attention from teachers and students because of her skills and looks. She is always unhappy with Seo Jin. Ban Da Yul is Seo Ha’s best friend, she always carries tarot cards with her and chants strange spells.

Once in a while, everyone has eerie imaginations about things that could happen in familiar settings -- a family apartment, on an elevator, on the way home from class and by the relaxing river. In each stand-alone episode, those imaginations are turned into urban tales that shatter the peace and normality of everyday life.

Peace returns to Earth after the Kyoryugers destroyed the Deboth Army. One day, a huge spaceship empowered by space dinosaurs approaches the Earth and unveils the Neo Deboth Army, who wishes for revenge against the Earth Zyudenryu and sought "the power of the dragon king" to conquer the planet.

Sensing their presence, Torin's spirit goes with Luckyuro and Candelilla to find the new "People of the Strong Dragons". An army of Zorima invaded the city, forcing idol Kim Se Chang and police officer Jeon Hyeon Jun to fend against them. During the fight, the child of the dragon Kwon Ju Yong joined in and fought against the Zorima army while a strange white dinosaur appeared on his shoulder. Seeing Daigo's image on Ju Yong, Torin entrusted the youth with GabuGaburivolver and the Zyudenchi.

Can the women’s association defend housing prices?! A showdown between gangster-like housewives, dead serious about protecting home values, who end up dumping a corpse in the Han River after an incident, to protect their view of the Han River, and a gangster-like redevelopment association chairman, dead serious about redevelopment.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "The Great Ok Suk" (위대한 방옥숙) written by Mae Mi (매미) and illustrated by Hui Se (희세).
Kim Soo is the representative of the best Korean clothing brand. Kang Yoo Na is a designer who works for the company. They meet and fall in love.
Two high school boys growing and getting mature together. They are thinking about their dreams and future.
About Gi Jun , a single working dad who suddenly divorces and meets his former subordinate, Hui Jin, in front of a kindergarten, where their relationship is reversed.
dramas.t: tvN O'PENing: Mission the Birthday Invitation

dramas.syn: A story of ex-lovers reuniting as a director and lead character of a webdrama. The main character who does not believe in love, writes a romance drama and various realistic things happen due to it.

“Chung Chun Hyang Jeon” will tell the story of 24-year-old Chun Hyang in 2021, who works as a staff member at a guesthouse to repay her student debt. She fell in love with Mong Ryong when she was 18, but lost contact with him for six years after he moved to Seoul. He suddenly returns as a medical student, but a young entrepreneur named Byun Hak Do shakes things up for the couple.

~~ The drama is inspired by renown tale of Chunhyang.

In Korea, many married couples have dual incomes while raising kids. Affluent couples have the luxury of hiring nannies and pricey SAT consultants for their college-bound children while poor and lower middle class families with kids have to juggle childcare responsibilities while balancing work. In a society where young married couples are encouraged to have children without any provincial or government support for families with kids, working Korean couples are grappling with the issue of childcare. This TV series illustrates these issues and asks viewers what choice they would make for the sake of their children.
Four men and women love each other for who they are. A realistic unrequited love story from a third-person point of view.

Cheong A is the most popular girl at her elite, private high school. She's used to getting her way and being fawned over. But her perfect life comes crashing down when Re Na transfers to her school. While trying to bring Re Na under her thumb, Cheong A discovers that she is secretly the daughter of a powerful political family, and Re Na discovers that Cheong A's glamorous life has been a lie!
dramas.t: Bitch X Rich: In the Drawing Class

dramas.syn:
Tells the story of Princess Eun Myeong, the king’s daughter, who loses her mother, the Queen, at a young age and grows up lonely within the strict confines of palace life. She falls in love at first sight with the scholar Kim Seo Yul and decides to marry him. However, their families share a long-standing conflict and ill-fated history, leading to entangled relationships and unexpected power struggles.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Covet the Scholar, Princess" (공주, 선비를 탐하다) written by Seo Eun Su (서은수) and illustrated by HOSAN (호산).

It is an anthology consisting of eight independent stories that explore moments of love, separation, and personal growth through “that song”—a song that everyone has encountered at least once in their life.

The story unfolds around a palace romance in which Crown Prince Yi Hyeon, a former war hero confined to the Western Palace amidst power struggles, and Eun U, an assassin disguised as a court lady to eliminate him, are drawn to each other. It heightens dramatic tension by intensifying the conflict structure between characters and regulates the pacing with comedic elements placed throughout.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Wild Eyes" (광안) written by Yook Mi Hwa (육미화) and illustrated by So Ra (소라).
dramas.t: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince

dramas.syn: The drama’s about a young single mother raising a five-year-old daughter on her own, maintaining a positive attitude while working part-time jobs.
Seven lifelong friends reunite and discover they all had a crush on the same girl, who confessed?

The drama follows the story of a father and three brothers. 

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Joseonwangjosiltok" (조선왕조실톡) by Super Pink (무적핑크).
“Our Baseball” tells the story of a baseball team made up of normal office workers. Park Jeong Hwa will play a character on a job search who is the only woman on the baseball team.

Han Mu Cheol, nicknamed "K-Scrooge", is a ruthless miser and wealthy landlord who values money over everything, even his family. His greed begins to backfire when misfortune strikes. His high school rival and current tenant, Kim Dae Sik, a devoted father running a chicken shop with his wife, faces bankruptcy after Mu Cheol raises the deposit. Their mutual friend Choi Gyu Tae, a smooth-talking real estate agent managing Mu Cheol’s buildings, struggles to secure funds for his son's urgent heart surgery, revealing the cracks in their relationships and values.
"The Secret of Secret" is about the courage of the main characters to heal wounds and call for human rights in the face of discrimination.
One day, a dog name Lea shows up at Seul Gi's house, who is a loner struggling with mental health. Lea has a speaker on her collar that can process her thoughts into words, allowing her to talk.

Gong Ji Hoon, CEO of an AI art collection startup, will participate in "Constar IR Day," the last opportunity for the business. Kim Jae Hee, the youngest director of Constar, gets involved with Gong Ji Hoon in a public and private way... Gradually, work and love coexist.

"Working part-time is better than being the store manager."
A convenience store drama about Ha Ru who became a part-timer with 9 years of experience with customers and newbie store managers.
It is a story about two friends who fall in love but decides to be friends

Three women share a close bond that was deeper than any friendship. Song Ah, Sen Na, and Hyun Ah were both the same age and went to the same schools. Song Ah was an especially giving friend who would do anything for a friend. She absolutely trusted Sen Na and treated her like a sister along with her twin sister Hyun Ah. She thought they would always maintain a close relationship. But she had no idea that Sen Na was planning revenge.
A two-part short film to raise awareness about hearing-impaired people who wear cochlear implants. Depicts a chance encounter between a hearing-impaired woman and a non-disabled man.
The story of a man struggling to regain his girlfriend's memory as she suffers from memory loss.
A man who firmly believes in star ratings goes on a disastrous blind date with a woman who only has a one-star rating due to a system error in a dating app.
Four men and women can't sleep because of love.

A fantasy anthology drama about Hong Yeon, the owner of a store, and Jeong Ju, an unexpected customer, against the backdrop of "Timetable", a restaurant for the dead in a space that exists between this world and the afterlife.

The story centers around a man and woman who have different perspectives and memories when it comes to love. The scenes in the drama will be split into a man’s point of view and a woman’s point of view to show how the same situation is remembered differently by the man and the woman.
Ji-Young has a bright personality. Due to a difficult situation, she becomes a surrogate mother. With her bright personality, she gets through hardships and struggles to obtain happiness.

Eun Hye who used to be a recognized editor of one of the best magazines for women in Korea quit her job and set up a start-up named Issue Makers. Although it's been two years since its establishment, it hasn't accomplished much, and all it has is its website. But Eun Hye gets an opportunity of life to expand its market overseas. Things start to go hectic and frantic in Issue Makers' office as it is about to launch its first magazine in Vietnam. Check out how Eun Hye and other staff members deal with busywork, cherish friendship, lead a love life, and realize dreams.

Han I Seo, a reclusive heiress returning from Africa, is mistaken for a penniless charity worker and publicly humiliated by her ex and his family. But when a mysterious CEO, Yun Se Hyeon, sees something rare in her and proposes marriage, their union sends shockwaves through high society. As her enemies push too far, Han I Seo fights back—revealing her true identity as Thunder Lady, the secret CEO of the world’s most powerful investment syndicate.
dramas.t: Honey, Guess Who’s the REAL BOSS

dramas.syn: Ran Ho is the sweet and thoughtful best friend to Roxanne, and has been in love with her since they first met 5 years ago. When a new co-worker joins their company, Roxanne falls in love at first sight and confides in Ran Ho. Ran Ho being the nice guy he is, plays the matchmaker between the two, because he wants to see her happy - even if it means he might not be part of it.
NA

As the couple whose story captured the attention of fans the world over, the stars of “Wish You” (2020), Kang In Soo and Lee Sang, have stolen more than a few hearts. Now it’s time to get to know the men behind one of 2020’s favorite new couples.

To thank fans for their love and support, Kang In Soo and Lee Sang have prepared a little something special. Taking questions from their fans, the two actors will be satisfying their fan’s burning curiosity in a very special Q&A session. In addition, Kang In Soo and Lee Sang will be sharing some of their favorite moments both on and off the screen during an incredible live chat.

Marco, a guy living with a trauma from a dead girlfriend, is a psychiatrist who treats students living on the 88th street. The drama shows how Marco helps students get over their traumas and make connections with others and the world again.

My scary superior who made me quake in fear during my rookie employee days is back. But let's not be scared. Now it's team leader versus team leader! But... where did the tiger go? And why is there a fox here? You... Are you really the person I once knew?! My former superior, Baek Seon Ho, came back after making a one-eighty. A heart-thumping office romance with him begins with an intense entangling!

~~ Adapted from the web novel “A Hearty Confession" (찐한 고백) by Rose Bean (로즈빈).

One day your mom gets married and now you have three sisters!
But what will you do when suddenly your parents die in a plane crash and find out they never registered their marriage so you were never legally a family?! Are they still your sisters?

When the Snow Queen takes Nam Ji Seob with her so that he can be the ice prince, the only way Seo Ga Eun, Nam Ji Seob's childhood friend and a webtoon writer in seclusion, can save him is by finding 7 memories in time. It's just like finding 7 pieces of the puzzle. So with the help of the doll knight, she tries to save Ji Seob. In this adventure, Ga Eun encounters Fairies, Yeti, Snow Queen and many interesting Korean retro characters.

Babel Syndrome depicts the stories of various people who lost their spoken language due to an epidemic that spread a deadly virus, which causes genetic modification. Ha Neul, a young student who dreams to become a poet one day. He has a pure, kind heart who longs for his first love. His perspective about the world changes after he learns the darkest secrets hidden by the society during the deadly epidemic.

The policeman's wife is missing. One year and three months later, his wife returned. The wife died with the child of the killer, the kidnapper, and the child was born. The culprit was not arrested. 20 years later, a boy who has the killer's blood in his veins but was raised by his adoptive father, who is a police officer. A father who tries to protect his son from his son's biological father. A killer who has been tracking down his son in order to continue the evil chain. It is a story about the choices and fates of three men.

Ha Yeong, shaped by a life of constant moving, keeps people at a distance until she unexpectedly opens her heart to Hui Won. When they attend the same school, the two create an Eternal List, a promise of things to do together as adults. After Hui Won breaks that promise, Ha Yeong's time comes to a halt, and she retreats to a cafe attic, cut off from the world. One day, Do Un appears holding the long-lost list, and with his arrival, Ha Yeong's frozen time begins to move again. Can a promise from the past lead them back to the present?
The story of Jung Ah Yoon struggling with a long distant relationship, that is kept alive through online gaming.
dramas.t: Things That May Occur to You Today

dramas.syn: Seung Bae is a “sociable” grandpa who enters college at age 75, to realize his final dream in life. Min Goo is an “introvert” youth who struggles to balance both his studies and his part-time job and is tired of life. The two opposites form an unexpected bond, when fate brings them together as roommates at the university dormitory.

About the meeting of the world's first female promoter and a hard-working boxer, and every moment they cry, grumble, and cheer each other on until the day he becomes a world champion, brimming with humanity.

Sim Yeong Ja is the world's first female promoter. She transforms from Ko Su Mi, a popular actress who dominated the 1970s, into Sim Yeong Ja, the world’s first female boxing promoter. Known in her high school days as “Sim Dark,” she is a character with powerful charisma and a strong sense of justice who, through her forward-thinking strategies, shook up the boxing scene of the 1980s, a time when women were often excluded.

Jang Jeong Gu, WBC Light Flyweight boxer is a naturally talented boxer who repeatedly falls short of winning championships due to disqualifications.

Shining Nara tells the story of a sixth grader named Nara who no longer wants to be a child. One day she finds a makeup kit and decides to use it. As a result, she became a 16 year old girl and disguises herself under the name Bitna to approach her brothers friend who’s training to be an idol only to end up training as an idol herself to be close to him. How will Nara be able to keep her true identity a secret?

South Korea can no longer be considered a drug-free country. The drug epidemic is so widespread that meth has been detected in sewage collected from sewage treatment plants. When the government realizes that the police force is not enough to solve the problem, they bring in Kim San, a top NIS agent.

Through his investigation, San discovers the largest meth lab in South Korea since the country’s founding. And it turns out that the Triad is behind it all. San, determined to stop the drug at its source, travels to Taiwan. As he fights his way to the truth, he realizes that the operation is a lot bigger than it seems. The Triad have been planning to move their entire drug manufacturing operation to Korea, funded by none other than the Japanese Yakuza.

To protect their investment and assets, the Yakuza and Triad join forces. San stands tall against all of them. He’s ready to crush them…

Me Li is a conglomerate's daughter who runs away to the East Sea to avoid a political marriage; she disguises herself as a man and starts a new job at a surfing shop. She becomes entangled with Ha Il, who is afraid of waves due to past trauma.
Yeo Bin had a dream that Young Jae confessed to her while carrying someone on his back but why does it seem so real?

A modern-day “Prince and the Pauper” revenge story in which a poor job-seeker, who barely secures a position at a company, is fired and even goes to prison on behalf of the owner’s heir simply because they look alike. She then joins forces with other underdogs (“Eul”) to overthrow the “king.” The drama follows the journey of a once-kind ordinary citizen as she navigates the gray area between good and evil, delivering thrilling battles, romance, and the rise of a villain we can’t help but root for.

One day, Ha Na wakes up to find herself in the world of a romance novel—as the first fiancée of the male lead. The problem? Her character is a minor one destined to be poisoned at the engagement party of Cheon Nam Ju, heir to the Cheonnam Group. To avoid her tragic fate, Ha Na proposes a contract marriage to Park U Jin, the notorious "tyrant" and acting chairman of the rival Samjeong Group. U Jin accepts the offer, and Ha Na’s destiny begins to veer in an unpredictable direction.

How much can your past stand in the way of your future?
Jina has always dreamed of becoming a singer in a girl group. But her family’s tough financial situation forced her to give up that dream and instead go to work to support herself. But years later when she is given an opportunity to participate in “Finding New Angel,” a girl group survival competition, Jina is determined to do whatever it takes to win the competition. But who can be exposing the secrets of her past through an app called T-Scope that could derail her chances of winning?

A noir drama that unfolds against the backdrop of Jeju Island, delving into the fierce rivalry among three influential families the Bus, the Yangs, and the Kos — as they fight to protect their lineage and legacy. 

The story centers on three powerful clans: the Bu family, who dominate Jeju through pig farming and the horse racing industry; the Yang family in Jeju City, who are expanding through real estate development; and the Ko family in Seogwipo, who once flourished via the casino business but have since faded. All three families engage in a brutal power struggle over their territorial and business interests.

dramas.nt: 러브 : 트랙 - 아빠의 관을 들어줄 남자가 없다
dramas.syn: The story of Su A, an only daughter who has to hold her father's funeral because, and who is worried about who should carry her father's coffin between her ex-boyfriend of 10 years and her current boyfriend of 100 days.

A crime-action entertainment drama about detectives who specialize in protecting victims of crimes that closely affect people's daily lives.

The story follows an unconventional detective, Hwang Cheon Gi who, while attending the police academy, was arrested for attempted murder as part of an undercover mission to infiltrate a criminal organization. He eventually rose to become one of the gang's leaders before bringing the organization down, leaving him "80% gangster" in both attitude and methods. He is paired with a police lieutenant who has been single-handedly responsible for safeguarding 128 victims in a single year.

Together, they protect victims by balancing the law and brute force, as well as reason and emotion.
Yu Ho and Jin Gu called it quits — and spent two years quietly falling apart. Now they're face to face again, and every feeling they buried is coming back.

>> Story 1: "History of Us" (사관은 논한다) [Director: Lee Ga Ram (이가람)]
It is the story of the Crown Prince, who tries to erase history in order to become the king and the young officer who tries to stop him.

>> Story 2: "Find Handsome!" (핸섬을 찾아라!) [Director: Son Seok Jin (손석진)]
Depicts the journey of a disbanded unknown idol member who dreams of making a comeback and searches for the missing former member, Handsome.

>> Story 3: "The Two Women" (영복, 사치코) [Director: Park Dan Bi (박단비)]
It is a story of a husband battle that unfolds in a village near the 38th parallel a year before the outbreak of the Korean War.

>> Story 4: "The Road in Between" (모퉁이를 돌면) [Director: Lee Hae Woo (이해우)]
It is the story of Seo Hu, a member of the Road View filming team who went through a painful breakup, and Eun Ha, who searches for her father, who was caught on Road View, groping her way through the path of…

It is a romantic sitcom about the lives of young men and women in their early 20s. It describes the stories of casts in an amusement park where 'Fatigue and Healing', 'Stress and Pleasure' and 'Sum and Ssam' coexist.
dramas.t: Cast: The Golden Age of Insiders

dramas.syn:
Depicts the success, love, and desire for power of the main characters who unfold overseas as the stage against the background of a global company.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Youngest Son of a Conglomerate" (재벌집 막내아들) by San Gyung (산경).

COVID-19, which had terrorized humanity, has finally ended, and the WHO has defined it as an endemic. However, Jung Yu Hyeon, a professor of infectious diseases at a Korean university hospital, is astonished to face a patient showing symptoms of a new virus.

The virus first infects the brain and heart, then causes the infected person to become brain-dead. After this, the infected people wake up as zombies. This is the worst virus that signals the end of humanity.

The virus controls the human brain and has a very strong survival instinct. Recognizing this, the government and the president decide that the virus is stronger than a nuclear weapon and proceed with a research project to create the virus as a biochemical weapon. In the end, they succeed in the mass production of the virus, but it is leaked into the middle of Seoul during a raid by intelligence agencies and terrorist groups…
A story of a college student named Han Mi Rae who gets stuck in a time loop on the last day of her trip to Japan after meeting a guy named Dong Joon.
A drama about a grandpa and his granddaughter, with very different personalities, who spend a weekend together and form a bond as they become friends.

Socrates said that a kiss is the greatest thief that steals one's heart. However, for Heung Mi it's different. She hears the sound of an ambulance instead of a heavenly bell whenever she kisses someone due to anaphylactic reactions. Meanwhile, Wan Jeon has a genetic disease that can only be treated through this most peculiar woman. The two of them agree on dating under certain conditions for the sake of treating each other's illnesses. Watch their romantic adventure unfold!
It tells the story of employees at Jin Entertainment, an entertainment company suddenly in danger of shutting down, and the employees' attempts to solve the mystery behind their company's crisis.
A long-term couple deceived by familiarity lost what's precious. They stumble into a motel after being stranded in heavy rain, only to encounter a serial killer.

A falling meteor gives a group of 20-something friends a newfound mission in life.

Choi Hee Yeol, Park Hae Mil, and their friends love to spend their time playing video games. After a falling meteor gives them strange new powers, the friends establish a gaming company called Meteor Soft to create new video games using their powers.

But when the major gaming company Next Media becomes threatened by Meteor Soft’s success, can Hee Yeol and his friends survive the tough corporate challenges they are about to face?

This season follows the dynamic second half of Private-turned-Corporal Park Min Seok's military life as he struggles with endless concerns after being promoted to corporal.

~~ Adapted from the web animation "New Recruit" (신병) by Jang Bbi Jju (장삐쭈).
~~ Versions: 12 episodes (TV) || 24 episodes (Online)

Yeo Reum is a singer-songwriter in a slump, and Kim Geon is Yeo Reum's number-one fan and director. Two people making music videos for their own reasons. She is called the ‘Icon of First Love’, but, who is her first love? The story of the making of a music video that goes back to her first love in the summer.

An office political noir about a person with no connections, no background, but an uncanny knack for political maneuvering, who overturns the power games of office mafia and breaks the "line."

Tak Do Il is the team leader of the Central Team at the Seoul Regional Headquarters of Nara Bank. Do Il is a graduate of a regional university, hired through blind recruitment, and while he couldn't even dream of competing with the elite "black ties" of the bank, he earns a commendation from the bank president for apprehending a voice phishing scammer. Thanks to that achievement, he moved to Seoul within a year of joining the company. Eventually, he becomes the "wannabe" of the black ties and plays a key role as the top "kingmaker."

Ji Yeong dreamed of becoming a pilot, but an unexpected pregnancy led her to give up her captain’s seat to her husband, Min Gyu, and become a housewife. On their seventh anniversary, she catches him cheating and dies in a plane crash. However, fate has other plans. She wakes up before the tragedy—and this time, she’s ready to take back the sky.
dramas.t: He Took a Mistress I Took the Sky

dramas.syn: A romantic comedy set in a traditional market in Myeongsan County, South Chungcheong Province. The drama follows a realistic debt collection lawyer who has spent his life focused solely on survival. After becoming involved with the people of the local market, he gradually discovers the true meaning of community, love, and family.

There's nothing that Hongik Super, a very popular supermarket doesn't sell. It even has a potion in stock that helps people get over their ex-lovers. This is all possible thanks to the supernatural power of Ms. Na Jeong Boon, the owner of Hongik Super. She can foresee the future and predict what her customers are going to need. She wants her son Myeong An to succeed her at Hongik Super when she learns he also has a special power. However, Myeong An doesn't want to take over the family business, and thinks his power is useless. When an unexpected customer frustrates Jung Boon, she takes a long leave. This forces Myeong An to look after the store. One day, Yeon Hee, his first love that he grew up with, visits Hongik Super. Myeong An decides to use his power for Yeon Hee.

Ki Pa Ran is a data analysis expert who loves food entered the food distribution company 'Meal Kid' and often get into conflicts with former idol, Ban Seok due to differences in opinion on the value of food.

An office romance web drama that deals with the small romance that is likely to occur in a relationship of a beginner in society. It deals with the sweet and bitter story of those who start their youth at the beginning of love with a company and a reading group in the background.
Depicting the reckless challenges, failures, and triumphs of prospective groom Lee Ro Woon, who transforms into a financial expert for 24 hours to recover the money he needs to buy a house.

Hui Won, an ER nurse, transfuses her own blood to save Tae Yeong, a mob boss who arrives with a gunshot wound — only to discover his deadly secret: hemophilia. On the day of her wedding, her fiancé's betrayal leaves her with nothing. Tae Yeong hands her a contract: be his fake wife for one year. With 3 billion won and her father's medical bills on the line, Hui Won is locked away in his mansion. She pushes back against his cold obsession and control, but slowly uncovers the loneliness and warmth hidden beneath his ruthless exterior — and the more she tries to escape, the deeper she falls.
dramas.t: Run from Me if You Can

dramas.syn: Yoon Hee Yeol dreams of being a singer. Yoo Eun Ho is an aspiring writer. These college students and their friends try to find the way towards their dreams.

A youth comedy-investigation drama dealing with the issue of social recluses. It follows Tae Baek Ho, who loses his dream of becoming a police officer due to a violent incident and later joins an unofficial civilian group called the “Reclusive Masters Foundation.”

The story unfolds as he helps solve different cases involving recluses in an omnibus format, with each episode focusing on a new individual. The series is said to be based on a real company that supports social recluses, called “Not a Scary Company.”
dramas.t: The Hidden Hikikomori Master: Tae Baek Ho

dramas.syn: A firefighter who lost his sight and a young man diagnosed with a terminal illness end up sharing a hospital room. At first, they clash with sharp words and defensiveness, but as they gradually learn about each other's pain and secrets, their distance turns into an unexpected closeness. And just as they finally begin to realize the meaning of love... one of them is already preparing for a final goodbye.
The drama tells stories of courageous prosecutors in Goyang's Investigative Task Force for Crimes Against Women and Children who uncover truth and fight for the weak who were silenced by injustice.

NewPlus original series, "AI, Her" is a sci-fi thriller of stories of various characters that start with the collapse of the boundaries between artificial intelligence and humans in an age when human brain information and experience are transmitted to computers.

The story of a family that founded a new nation.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Gukgaui Tansaeng" (국가의 탄생) by Gorita (고리타).

The story is about Da Mi, active as a statistician in 2000, who reminisces about her past when she starts working as a researcher again in 2020, and depicts a romance with Seok Jin, whom she met 20 years ago in the research institute training program.
An ordinary female protagonist in her twenties who has no easy things such as work, love, and relationships.

There are companies that enforce enthusiasm, fierce competition, and human relationships for survival. There are youngsters who got tired of life in Seoul and moved to a small town. Kim Oh Hoo was working for the company to fulfill his dream, but hard work doesn't always mean that you gain what you dream of. Oh Hoo gets exhausted by the company that wants to use all his time, so he resigns from the company and leaves to a small city, where he meets Shin Na Ra, Hyun Jae, and Yeo Un Shik. While staying with them, Oh Hoo starts to think about what happiness is.

Depicts the story of Lee Dong Min, who is a former idol group member with good looks, talent, and intelligence. He tasted success in the competitive music industry, but just before a major music broadcast, he suddenly disappears. Years later, he reappears as a PD in the entertainment industry.

Kyeong Suk married a wealthy older man at 19. After her mother-in-law's death and her husband's passing, she relies on her son Jeong Su, a doctor. When Jeong Su introduces his girlfriend Hyeon Ju, Kyeong Suk disapproves due to Hyeon Ju’s poor background. Despite this, they marry, and Kyeong Suk continues to trouble Hyeon Ju. After Jeong Su’s death in a car accident, the two women are no longer family. Both remarry, and through a twist of fate, Kyeong Suk becomes Hyeon Ju’s daughter-in-law.

A story of a bright young girl who lost her family during the Korean War and grew up experiencing the rapid change of the Korean society in the 1970s. The story of dream, love, loss, forgiveness, and reconciliation between two generations of characters who lived through the tumultuous period of 1st and 2nd Korean War, from the 1950s to 1970s.
dramas.t: TV Novel: My Mind’s Flower Rain

dramas.syn: A time-limited workplace romance about an unremarkable woman who happens to obtain a mysterious potion that makes the employees at her company fall in love with her for exactly 50 days.
The brutal story of the Kim family, who started a counterfeit money business again to pay for non-covered medicine, unexpectedly becoming entangled with criminal organisations.

Eun Sol is the only daughter of a CEO for a shoemaking company. She lives a happy life, but an unexpected incident causes her to lose her memory and she begins to live under the name of Dal Soon. She has a bright personality and takes an interest in shoes. Dal Soon reveals her past and succeeds as a shoe master.

During high school, Choi Jeong Min endured long-term bullying from Ha Ju Hyeon. Her only solace was taking revenge on Ha Ju Hyeon through "lucid dreaming" in a world where no one could interfere. One day, she encountered a mysterious man named Ju Jae Hyeon in her dreams, who offered to help her take revenge on all those who had hurt her. As the plan progressed, a subtle yet dangerous emotion began to grow between them...

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Dreaming Freedom" (꿈에서 자유로) by 2L.
A sitcom about a family that’s struggling to survive, living with the in-laws, and dreaming of getting back up on their feet.

The story of a couple about to divorce, who agreed to live together only until the down payment due to apartment subscription conditions. They then prepare for separation for a month before moving in.

About a leader of a gang of thieves who becomes a fake crown princess and meets the crown prince who cannot forget her even in his dreams, and they break up the power struggle between the powerful men who are causing chaos in the country and steal the hearts of the people.

It is about an editorial designer named Kim Na Yul, who has given up on dating due to her overwhelming workload. When she accidentally winds up seeing a new side of her workaholic boss, Kwon Si Jin, they become entangled in unexpected ways.

When Yoon Jung Won is betrayed by family and friends who she completely trusted, the realization that humans are cruel dawns upon her. This show revolves around an insurance planner who is framed for a crime that she did not commit and tries to find justice after serving out her sentence in prison. There is a message of hope in the story in that while pain is inflicted on her by people around her, she eventually finds comfort and assistance from new people she encounters later.

Three women who shared a terrible secret twenty years ago during school years are reunited after they find themselves living in the same apartment complex. They now lead different lives but share the same problem with their husbands who are cheaters. Now, these three housewives, all betrayed by their husbands, bond together to revenge. Through the characters' proactive approach in trying to resolve their marital problems, this show will give the female viewers a cathartic relief.
Short yet heartwarming story about food, friendship, and life. It tells the story of two innkeepers and their guests, who come for healing.
A drama that deals with the conflict of a mother, Yeong Mi, who finds out her son's secret through a threatening text message.

Ah Chim is a 20-something girl who is just starting out in her career. "Poetry Story" chronicles her relatable adventures and challenges as well as her personal and social life, from shopping to dating. Things that could happen to any newbie at an office are shown through Ha Sang Wook's poems in this drama.

“Nineteen” is a drama in the form of a vlog  in which the protagonist shares her daily life and tells a story through video. The main character is Han Sung Min, a model and new actor who is receiving the most attention in the fashion and beauty industry. “Nineteen” is as an interactive content in which the protagonist directly communicates with subscribers and creates a story, adding to the expectation. Han Sung Min is a person who has a beautiful appearance and a stylish sense, but struggles with 'love', and plans to proceed with a relationship by referring to the comments of subscribers on the content.
The drama pleasantly captures the joys and sorrows of a new employee who isn't afraid to voice out and a middle manager.
“Descendants of the Airport” is a web drama about the daily events that occur at the airport. Niel is a hard-working security officer who meets a beautiful long-haired girl while on duty.
This romantic comedy is about Yoo Kam Woo, who can only drink about two sips of beer, and Do Eum Joo, an extreme alcohol enthusiast.
It is a teen romance web drama that tells the stories of teenagers, their worries, changes, and new starts.

A web series that deals with the wants and desires of people who want to be together, but for some reason do not have the courage or just are not, and how they overcome their difficulties and fear to find love.
dramas.t: I Want to Do It with You

dramas.syn: Lee Seol writes an R-rated novel for a competition using her first love, Cha Si U, as inspiration for her male lead. Top-notch producer Cha Si Hyeok is hired to help her make her novel a best-seller, but when he appears, he looks exactly like Cha Si U! He doesn't seem to remember her, and he is nothing like her kind first love from the past, but Seol hides her identity anyway, too embarrassed to face him after basing her male protagonist on him.
Comprised of 3 episodes, the sitcom follows the story of four girls living together in a share house, where every day is full of fun and laughter.

About Choi Do Wan, who has crashed his career in baseball and dreams of a second chapter in his life through the reunion consulting app "Reboot", and his cheeky ex-girlfriend who comes to him asking for reunion consulting with another man. It is a romantic comedy about Kang Eun Gyo and the thrilling romantic journey of two people with 2 outs in the bottom of the 9th inning.
The story revolves around Na So Nyuh’s love life prior to becoming a top star, as she reflects on her experiences with her four ex-boyfriends, one of which had too made their debut in the industry.

Set in the 1960s and 1970s, Yoon Soo In is consistently a top-ranked student in school, but due to her family's struggling financial circumstances, she begins to work at a factory instead of going to college. She nevertheless pursues her dreams.
dramas.t: TV Novel: A Sea of Her Own

dramas.syn: Depicts the romantic meeting of four men and women in a thrilling airplane, an airport, and an unfamiliar city.

Lee Si Chan is a brilliant but emotionally detached surgeon whose life takes a dramatic turn after he is suspected of being involved in a suicide. Abandoning everything, he begins working in psychiatry, where he slowly starts to open up and confront the emotional barriers he has long kept locked away. Despite his appealing appearance, he has a difficult and abrasive personality. Once a troublemaking intern, he gradually grows into a psychiatry resident and, ultimately, a true “mind doctor.”

~~ Adapted from the web novel “Mind Doctor" (마인드 닥터) by Do Won (도원).
Witnessing her boss’s unusual tastes, the power dynamic flips in an instant! An intense love–hate romance begins between employee Jang Se Yeon and team leader Kang Seung Gi.

A romance about an innocent young man named Yoo Jae Hyung, whose family has kept an apple farm for four generations, and Gong Sun Mi, the only daughter of a local politician and contractor. After attending a prestigious women's college in the United States, she dreams of creating a theme park bigger than Disney in Cheongsong.

~~ Based on a folktale of the Cheongsong region.

This drama is about 3 middle age-women, Cha Jin Ok, Oh Dal Sook and Nam Mi Rae. They are friends who graduated from the same high school and they believe they are leading happy lives, but they face a crisis in their lives.

A college student struggling with friendship starts a new job as a convenience store only to find out that the owners are fairies. The fairies only have one condition for their workers and that is that they have to tell the fairies all of their worries. Together the part timer and the fairies work to find happiness.

'College Life Everybody Wants' is a story about Green, who entered an advertisement club that was not thought of as an accidental opportunity, and Do Heon, the chairman of a club where everything is perfect, meet Green and grow together.

"I'm not even 60 yet! "Just call me an ahjussi." 58-year-old oldest, Dae Hee. It's been a long time since his wife Bong Seon and son Dong Min came home, and no one contacted him even on his birthday. Then came a phone call out of nowhere from his son. "Dad, I lost all my money". It can't end like this. He starts to get work as a part timer, he meets Sim Chung, a young kkondae in her 20s, and learns life well once again. Kkondaehee, who still wants to love and to be loved, this is his happiness finding project! A web drama, featuring alter ego of comedian Kim Dae Hee, 'Kkon Dae Hee', other comedians and Weeekly's Lee Soo Jin!
Related to road traffic signs as a work that tells the story of a person who becomes a surrogate driver after being laid off at work.

“If I could go back in time, I would not fall in love with you...” People fall in love with one person but then marry another. The girlfriend of one brother is actually the past lover of the younger brother while the fiancée of the younger brother has a crush on the big brother. It was difficult for the younger brother to forget his ex-girlfriend who was now parading around as his brother’s girlfriend but he had to keep her out of his mind in order to get revenge and take back what was his. But most of all, it was about surviving and avoiding being murdered. So he finds himself maintaining his distance with his brother’s girlfriend and past lover but not too obvious because they could become in-laws. There is also the matter of carrying out his plot for revenge surreptitiously. “Reverse” is a psychological thriller that brings together four people entangled in a web of love and secrets.
It's a journey about technology and humans and how humanity mingles around with the advancements of science.

Park Min Seok is now promoted to private first class at Myth Unit. He believes his military life will become easier because of the promotion, but Oh Seung Yoon gets assigned to Myth Unit as Park Min Seok’s new company commander. Oh Seung Yoon is the FM company commander and he decides to change Myth Unit completely.

~~ Adapted from the web animation "New Recruit" (신병) by Jang Bbi Jju (장삐쭈).
Wisdom and the Nam Sachin's Su Ju, Ho Tae, Jin Hui, and Tae Hyeon's romantic comedy between reality and unrealism.
