Back in high school, Kim Eun Tae, Kam Seong Hun and Seo Do A were in a band called greenU's, though Seong Hun and Eun Tae disliked each other. Years later, after opening a mysterious package with no recipient, the two somehow switch bodies and become transported back in time.

What are the missing writing kids who dreamed of becoming a writer doing now? We meet again, with the little girl who used to roll her pen around the faded manuscript. Through the memories and love of forgotten writing children, we want to restore the excitement of a dull heart to young people who are still dreaming.

A historical drama that tells the tragic story of twin sisters born with the intertwined fates of a king and a traitor, and their journey to write a new history.

Yi Hyo, the king’s second son, known as Prince Ok Ryeon. Unlike his older brother, the crown prince, Yi Hyo is bold, battle-driven, and deeply skilled in martial arts. From a young age, he proves himself as a formidable warrior, even achieving major battlefield feats in his teens. Though he possesses both intellect and physical prowess, his fierce and combative nature sets him apart within the royal family.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Nameless Lantern" (무명의 등불) by Lee Jae (이재).

A black comedy about a flood of counterfeit money that overwhelms South Korea—so realistic that it looks more real than the genuine article. Some of the bills are even hand-drawn stitch by stitch by a color-blind artist, raising questions about whether they are fake, real, or art. In a world where money reigns supreme yet nothing truly exists before one’s eyes, the story follows a “fake man” who wants to become real, going beyond law, order, and morality.

A romantic comedy about an ordinary office worker who discovers that the virtual idol group member who helps them endure their exhausting everyday life is actually their own demanding boss. As the boss secretly debuts as a virtual idol and juggles a precarious double life, the two become entangled in an unexpected romance filled with comedy, workplace conflicts, and hidden identities.

After receiving news of his sister's sudden death, Si On travels to Australia determined to uncover the truth. Isolated in a strange city, he is forced to face unsettling secrets while zeroing in on Min Hyeok - a mysterious man who appears to be hiding what really happened to Si Yeong.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “'G'Day" (그다이) by Choi Yong Seong (최용성).

Lee Jin Woo is the heir of a declining photo studio that also works as a news photographer. He lights up the photo studio late every night and finds out that there are mysterious guests who come in and out of place.

During the Unified Silla period, five men and women who were burned at the stake after practicing the forbidden alchemy walked out of the ashes and came back to life a few days later. The king called them gods and named them the five immortals: Black Tortoise, Blue Dragon, White Tiger, Yellow Dragon, and Red Bird. These five families grew in power under the protection of these gods and became their servants for generations, becoming the bond between the gods and the world. However, during the Joseon Dynasty, the Black Tortoise suddenly disappeared. 

In 2024, another immortal, Yellow Dragon, disappears, and Black Tortoise's servant dies. The Black Tortoise, who had been living in hiding for a long time, senses the dark schemes of the four immortals. And then, as if by fate, the granddaughter of the Black Tortoise family, Eun Hwa, appears before him. He vows to join forces with Eun Hwa,…

A story about a cold-blooded criminal psychologist and professor named Ma Teresa, who investigates unsolved murder cases. She's joined by her assistant Park Seol, whose innocent looks hide a secret, and her long-time friend and prosecutor Yoo A Ram, as the three come to confront long-hidden truths and emotions.

When Ma Teresa is asked to consult on high-profile cold-case murder investigations, her assistant, Park Seol, is eager to help, craving her attention. Meanwhile, Yoo A Ram is wary of Park Seol lingering by Teresa’s side. As Ma Teresa interrogates criminals to uncover clues and comes closer to the long-desired truth, she finds herself swept up in unexpected emotions.

A Michelin one-star Italian chef is transported 1,000 years into the past by a mysterious prophecy and finds himself in Silla, where he meets Princess Deok Yeong — a gifted gourmet, pure-blooded seonggol, and royal determined to become Silla’s first queen.

When the ambitious princess challenges him to prove what true “taste” means, his modern culinary skills become his only way to survive in the ancient kingdom. As food brings two people from different eras closer, their encounter sparks a unexpected romance destined to transcend 1,000 years of time.

A romance drama that evokes childhood innocence, about a PD from a documentary background who is semi-forced into taking charge of a children's program and recalls the precious values ​​of life that had been forgotten under the weight of time.
~~ Remake of the French TV series "Call My Agent!" (Dix pour cent) [2015].

A healing story about Ma Han Sang, a gangster with exceptional cooking skills, who rescues a college student in danger and then hides out at the student’s home. Through warm, home-cooked meals, the two gradually offer each other comfort and encouragement.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Kyohan" (侠飯) by Fukuzawa Tetsuya (福澤徹也).

Armed with the supernatural ability to see exact unpaid tax amounts floating above people's heads, a blacklisted former employee joins the National Tax Service to ruthlessly dismantle corrupt elites and tax evaders.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "The Tax Reaper" (국세청 망나니) by Wintersleep Turtle (동면거북이).

A few years ago, Dan A, a government employee at the Ministry of Finance, was forced to take on the burden of raising children, housework, and making a living alone due to her husband’s declaration to enter Yeouido. In her dispatched location in St. Lucia, she experiences an absurd incident where she is cut off from the outside world due to an electricity supply problem. After many twists and turns, she successfully returns home… but as soon as she steps foot on the airport, what catches her eye is the news of her husband’s election?! Dan A’s divorce request is not accepted, and to make matters worse, when her personal information is leaked nationwide, she decides to choose divorce after her term rather than the red letter of the president’s divorcee, and begins a contract marriage. Since then, Dan Ah surprises the nation by showing unique behaviors that maintain her career. Meanwhile,…

On an ordinary afternoon after school, three friends encounter a murderer who has broken into an empty house. After losing his friends in the horrific incident, Jun Hwi prepares a dangerous counterattack to catch the culprit himself.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "After School" (방과후에) by Kwon Gol Su (권골수).

An Do Il, a trauma surgeon who regresses back to his days as a rookie doctor. After regressing, he gains the ability to see people’s remaining lifespans. Using his supernatural powers and exceptional medical skills, he treats various patients while resolving corruption and conflicts.

~~ Adapted from the web novel “Hoegwihaetdeoni SSSgeup Uisa" (회귀했더니 SSS급 의사) by Gulliver W (걸리버W).
A comic fantasy drama in which three fairies from the human world accidentally inherit the shabby neighborhood bathhouse 'Taewonjang'.

A humanistic comedy legal family drama about a mother of three children who was betrayed by her husband through a “transit divorce” (a term referring to leaving one relationship for another without a clean transition) and becomes a family court domestic relations investigator. She investigates various family law cases filled with bitter conflicts, searching for the truth and the key to reconciliation.

The drama portrays the fascinating cases handled by domestic relations investigators and their realistic struggles, while depicting the growth story of a fearless divorced woman who becomes a family court investigator to protect the children she loves.
~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Friendly Competition" (선의의 경쟁) written by Song Chae Yoon (송채윤) and illustrated by Shim Jae Young (심재영).
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jungjeung Oesang Senteo: Goldeun Awo" (중증외상센터: 골든 아워) by Hansan iga (한산이가).

Tells the story of an overly involved mother who enrolls in college later in life and begins redesigning the second chapter of her life.

Yun Ok Hui, a passionate mother who runs an instant tteokbokki restaurant. She is the head of the women’s association in Yeonyeon-dong and takes on all kinds of community roles, including school commute safety leader, parking order supervisor, resident center civil complaint mediator, and manager of the neighborhood group chat.

The admissions office of Q University, whose mission to increase the competition rate for college entrance exams is a burning flame, is scouting Ro Hui, a famous admissions officer from A University, but the shocking words that come out of her mouth at the entrance information session are, “Everyone with a grade below 3, please leave.” Ro Hui, a new type of admissions officer who shouts, “Inflated hopes are a failure in college entrance exams,” is gaining fame as the 'Fact Violence Admissions Officer' and shaking up YouTube’s In-Gyeop-Dong and the admissions office. 

Meanwhile, Yu Seok, a Korean language teacher at a high school, is busy encouraging his students as a homeroom teacher for third-year students, but he is surprised twice: once by Ro Hui’s shocking words and once by the fact that she was a former classmate. The values ​​of Ro Hui, a cool-headed admissions officer, and Yu…
dramas.t: This Is the Q University Admissions Office

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "Salon De Holmes" (살롱 드 홈즈) by Jeon Geon Woo (전건우).

Set during the era of the Fifth Republic in the 1980s, the story follows a National Intelligence Service agent who has sworn absolute loyalty to the state and goes undercover as the head of a broadcasting station’s dance team in order to carry out a mission to uncover spies.

Baek Seo Gyeong is an elite agent with a cold-headed and tenacious personality, who places the organization and her mission above all else. While controlling the team members and carrying out the operation, she undergoes unexpected changes and leads the narrative from the center of the story.

In an era when vaccines designed to suppress romantic feelings among teenagers have become widespread, Lee Do experiences love for the first time after meeting transfer student Bo Ram Chan. However, the excitement is short-lived when life-threatening side effects begin to appear, putting their first love at risk.
dramas.t: You Pour Down on Me: No Love Zone

dramas.syn:
A bad guy has fallen into a place even better than heaven!

~~ Remake of the American TV series "The Good Place" [2016].

The story follows a woman who, after being abandoned by her fiancé, her older sister, and even her parents, is sent back 15 years into the past. Determined to take revenge on everyone who betrayed her, she awakens with a single goal—to become queen.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “I’m the Queen in This Life" (언니, 이번 생엔 내가 왕비야) written by Omin and illustrated by REDICE (레드아이스).

A coming-of-age SF romantic comedy that unfolds when a man who wants to avoid making choices—and faces a 100% failure rate—experiences a malfunction in a simulation game that has been guiding him to the best possible options.
A singer-songwriter discovers an animal language translator after losing her pet cat embarks on a journey to uncover her cat's final message.

A delightful investigative action drama about a bounty hunter, Park Chang, who was a former police officer, and his three brothers, Park Cheol and Park Sal, who take down criminals in one fell swoop. Park Chang, who used to be a detective in the violent crimes unit but now makes a living off of bounties, Park Cheol, a police officer who wanted to be a teacher, and Park Sal, a detective in the criminal information unit who sometimes turns a blind eye to injustice for the sake of his career. The three brothers, who have different ideals and goals, come together with one belief that 'we cannot just turn a blind eye to criminals who have committed crimes' and punish criminals.

A rigid, principled prosecutor and a precious, upright satto (a magistrate of the Joseon era), who step into each other’s worlds, must protect the woman they both love from a time-traveling serial killer.

A fate-defying, body-swapping historical romance that transcends eras.

If a red box with your name written on it was placed in front of his house, would you open it?

On the morning of his police officer exam, Choi Do Ik receives a box with his name on it. A small, unmarked red box contains nothing but a mysterious note. The contents of the note are unsettling, but he sets out to take the exam. From then on, strange events unfold before him, and he becomes embroiled in a series of mysterious incidents.

"If only I hadn't opened that box back then..." Do Ik isn't the only one to receive a red box. Elsewhere, others who have received red boxes reveal their existence one by one. As they strive to uncover the secrets surrounding the box, mysterious incidents occur one after another. Furthermore, the detective identifies Do Ik as a prime suspect and begins to track him down...

No matter what, no matter what method, fate works its way. No matter how much Do Ik…
~~ Adapted from the novel series "Again My Life" (어게인 마이 라이프) by Lee Hae Nal (이해날).

Set in the imperial court of a fictional country called Eun, it tells the romance between Consort Hyeon Gae Ri—who possesses stunning beauty but is violent and intensely jealous, earning her the nickname “dog flower”—and Emperor Eon, a handsome yet cool-headed man.

~~ Adapted from the novel “The Wicked Queen" (궁에는 개꽃이 산다) by Yun Tae Ru (윤태루).

It started with a chance encounter in a secluded garden. You know, your typical boy-meets-girl romance. So then, why does he keep chasing her down and asking to see her photos? And hold up—he’s advertising for a wife?! Jeong Won just wants to survive her college years, but this business executive isn’t making it easy! She doesn’t have time for distractions between taking care of her siblings, working part-time, and studying for classes. But there’s another thing bothering her...who is the mysterious person leaving her notes?

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Four Ways to Find a Wife" (아내를 구하는 4가지 방법) written by Hyun Go Woon (현고운) and illustrated by Yoonda (윤다).
The story follows reporter Kang Chi Yeong and police officer Cha Jeong Won as they become entangled in an unimaginable incident and begin uncovering hidden secrets and buried truths.

Elite agents, seemingly ordinary in daily life but secretly hiding their identities, work to safeguard South Korean citizens abroad from international criminal threats in this high-stakes global spy action series..
Tells the story of someone whose gender is unclear at first but is later revealed to be a woman.

Kim Jin Hyeon had been living a life as a failed surgeon when, through a chance incident, he is given an opportunity to be reincarnated. When he returns, he finds himself back in the body of his middle-school self. Determined to make the most of this second chance at life, Jin Hyeon studies relentlessly.

His goal in this life isn't to become a surgeon, a difficult profession that doesn't pay well, but rather to become a dermatologist who makes a lot of money!

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Medical Return" (메디컬 환생) by Yu In (유인).

Federal Informant ‘Baek I Su’ and a criminal gang’s boss, ‘Baek Do Gyeong’ are twin brothers.

With the same faces the two twin brothers have lived different lives until now. Baek I Su, who’s been betrayed by the gang, throws away his identity to become his brother. This federal agent is soon to become the gang’s boss…!

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Mr. Baek" (백XX) by Byeongjang (병장) and Park Tae Jun (박태준).
The series follows married men who struggle to participate in amateur baseball, blending comedy with everyday life.

Bae Yong Geum, born into a family of con artists, was once a top performer at a multi-level marketing company. Desperate to live an ordinary life, she changes her name to Bae Yeon Hui, cuts ties with her family, and works tirelessly to earn admission to college.

However, on campus, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Yun I Gyeong, someone with whom she shares a troubled past. Cautious to keep her history hidden, Yeon Hui tries to stay out of trouble but unexpectedly becomes embroiled in a dating scandal.

As they spend more time together, love gradually blossoms between them, and they join forces to overcome the challenges they face. But when Yeon Hui’s history of fraud is suddenly exposed, she has no choice but to drop out and leave the university.
Finally, encouraged by I Gyeong, Yeon Hui finds the courage to confront her past and return to school. In doing so, she discovers true…
A comedic investigative historical series that follows Yong Gil, a servant who secretly infiltrates a noble household and becomes involved in solving various incidents and family problems.
A man who lost his direction in life and a woman who lost her place to stay after experiencing the same trauma 15 years ago embark on a journey to rebuild their lives and settle down.

A woman who has always lived a life focused only on herself and a man who has always cared about the lives of others become entangled in a redevelopment project, and in the process, they end up “redeveloping” true love. A healing romantic comedy.

A romance centered on two people who meet after crossing 50 years of time, creating a clash between two different eras. The story follows a man who has shut himself away because of his guilt over his father’s death, and a woman trapped by the constraints of her era who travels to modern times through time-slip, only to lose everything she once had.

Set in the Joseon era, a time when women were oppressed. The story follows a woman, Seo Hong, who defies her fate and embraces her desires, and a man, Seo Jae Ha, who loves her but must accept his own fate and conceal his desires.

Seo Jae Ha, the son of a butcher who grew up in a happy family, but whose life is shattered after his father’s death. He later takes on a new identity as the son of Seo Dong Won, the richest man in Hanyang. He develops complex feelings toward Seo Hong, whom he comes to know as his “sister.”

Seo Hong is the only daughter of Hanyang's wealthiest family. Defying the restrictions placed on women in the Joseon era, she paves her own way. Seo Hong is a determined and shrewd character who, through her intelligence and initiative, builds a successful trading business.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Night's Fragrance" (밤의 향) by Bori (보리).

In 2040, South Korea abolishes the death penalty and enacts a law granting victims’ families the right to punish offenders. Choi Tae Sik, a five-term congressman who had strongly opposed both the abolition and the new law, faces tragedy when his late-born daughter is abducted and murdered. Seventeen-year-old orphan Min U Hyeok is captured as the culprit but receives only a light juvenile sentence.

Persuaded by his wife—out of both repentance and political calculation—Choi adopts Min U Hyeok. Outwardly he plays the role of a father, yet inwardly he harbors an unrelenting desire to kill him. As years pass, hatred and a forced semblance of familial bond intertwine. Then, history repeats itself: Choi Tae Sik’s granddaughter is murdered in the very same way.

A woman who, by chance, boards a streetcar at Gyeongseong Station in 1937 and ends up getting off at Seoul Station meets a man who is a painter.
As she experiences Seoul with him and later returns to Gyeongseong, she begins to write about those experiences—marking the beginning of a fateful romance that transcends time and space between a woman of Gyeongseong and a man of Seoul.
A man whose mood mysteriously changes the weather and a female weather forecaster whose feelings mirror the weather come together in this happiness-protecting sci-fi romantic comedy.
A romantic comedy about a woman who has worked harder than anyone else but becomes burned out by the harsh realities of life, encountering three men by fate in a strange travel destination.

A story set in an amusement park, and follows the lives of workers who appear to have glamorous lives but grapple with the imperfections of everyday life. The sitcom explores the interactions and challenges of characters living together in dormitories, offering a blend of humor and poignant moments that reflect the realities of modern life.

dramas.nt: 사운드:트랙 - 나의 외로움이 널 부를 때
dramas.syn: A woman develops a one-sided crush on a man and cautiously approaches him after noticing his hidden loneliness.
dramas.t: Saundeu Teuraek: Naeui Oeroeuni Neol Bureul Ttae

dramas.syn:
'Se Jong's secret weapon, Shadow Unit informer.' Gwi Young, called the Ghost's Shadow, has been wandering around the battlefield since childhood. Vowing to get revenge, he decided to become a member of the nation's best special forces as an informer.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Chetamja" (체탐자) written by Byeong Jang (병장) and illustrated by Hae Seong (해성)
Depicts the struggles of a female protagonist who has been married and divorced three times to find her own happiness amidst the absolute support and subtle emotions of her ex-husbands.

Having never set foot in a kitchen his entire life, father Ha Eung cooks his very first homemade meal for his wife.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Father's Home Meal" (아버지의 집밥) by Gorigorita (고리타).

The story begins when an ordinary girl is kidnapped by a gang of bank robbers and confined in a remote mountain cabin.

Although she initially appears to be a vulnerable girl trembling in fear, there is a surprising truth behind her: she is actually “the strongest human being in existence.” Even under extreme circumstances, she remains calm as she searches for a way to escape, delivering an exhilarating sense of catharsis.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Girl vs Despair" (절망VS소녀) written by Masatokki (마사토끼) and illustrated by Do Hyeon (도현).
Cast interviews, NG, back scenes.

A mystery romance that follows a man and a woman who share similar pain and learn how to live again as hidden truths come to light. As the two—left alone in the world—fall in love, the ill-fated ties between them and long-buried secrets begin to unravel.

Ju Yeong In, an art teacher and painter living with the grief of losing her son, enduring her days by painting murals through sleepless nights.

Sin Jae I, the head of an architecture firm who possesses a pure, boyish charm and a free-spirited nature. Despite his bright personality, he lives with a major void caused by dissociative amnesia, and as the truth slowly surfaces, he finds himself facing confusion and emotional turmoil.

The story follows the youngest operator of a jjokbang village after he becomes entangled in the largest jeonse (lump-sum rental deposit) fraud scheme ever, and sets out to track down the landlord who disappeared without leaving a trace.

Kwon I An is a man who firmly believes in the give-and-take nature of business. He is calculating, ambitious, shrewd, and slightly cynical. As a high-end real estate agent, his pride comes from money—his earnings are both his greatest source of confidence and his calling card.

As childhood friends reunite to bring the landlord to justice, the drama unfolds as a satisfying revenge story about young people while also serving as an allegory for the contradictions and tragedies of modern capitalist society.

In a quiet village called Sae-dongne, retired killers live together in secrecy.
​
No resident shall ever use violence against civilians— except when the safety of Sae-dongne is at stake. But a storm is brewing as a massive new city development project sweeps through, led by the ruthless giant construction company, Kangsan Construction. Now, the village’s elders... former assassins, all must band together to protect their home. Can Sae-dongne survive the onslaught and keep its peace?

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "New Neighborhood" (새동네) by Im Seong Hun (임성훈).
A young person leaves behind faded friendships and embraces a new season alone.

A capable exorcist recognized by the Vatican. He expels demons with a powerful Holy Spirit that requires relics to subdue. Adopted to the United States as a child, he was abandoned again and raised in a church. He came to Korea in search of his biological parents, but was tricked by Mi Ho into coming to Jeju Island, where he stayed by her side and protected her.

It portrays the raw realities of desire and love surrounding one woman, telling the tragic story of Eun Ip Sae, a woman who achieved a perfect score on the college entrance exam and entered Seoul National University at the top of her class. While desperately trying to keep a dark secret hidden within her enviable past to survive, she deeply suffers due to the truths she chose to ignore and falls into an even more horrifying hell. The drama explores her tragic downfall and her gripping journey toward atonement.
Geum Gyul meets a businessman and a golf digger at a VIP country club and aims to start a new life.
dramas.t: Geumgyul: Mean Girls on the Green

dramas.syn:
The story follows Yoo Il Han, who has lived a life at rock bottom, when he suddenly receives news of the death of a father he has never known—along with the opportunity to inherit 1 trillion won.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Hwapye Gaehyeok" (화폐개혁) by Yun Pil (윤필) and Im Jeong Ho (임정호).
A woman tracks a fraudster who scammed her deposit, only to unexpectedly reunite with an old student, leading to an unforeseen chain of events.
A woman is forced to sacrifice lives on an operating table to avenge her deceased brother.
A cyberpunk story set in a near-future South Korea, that blends K-pop with futuristic technologies such as UAM (Urban Air Mobility) and robotics.
Scholars and commoners risk their lives to protect the Joseon Dynasty's historical records during the 1592 Imjin War.

A superpowered gambling action movie about Jin Gu, a man with X-ray vision, who jumps into a dangerous high-stakes game to take revenge on In Ju, the superpowered enemy who drove him to rock bottom.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Betting Man" (베팅맨) written by Dol Dom (돌돔) and illustrated by Yang Gaeng (양갱).

dramas.nt: 금귤이2 : 두 여자 두 남자의 사정
dramas.syn: Sang Hun and Jun Yeong fight over Geum Gyul. Han Na joins in, starting a high-stakes 2-on-2 golf match.
A detective, the sole survivor of her sister’s death, investigates a recurring serial murder 13 years later.
~~ Remake of the American TV series "Your Honor" [2020], which in turn is a remake of the Israeli TV series "Kvodo" (כבודו) [2017].
My house turned into a drug investigation unit HQ overnight. Wait, the suspect… is my crush?
dramas.t: Operations Center: Agents in My House

dramas.syn:
Thinking she's all by herself on the last train home, Na Yeon feels the urge to enjoy herself by fantasizing about her desires. However, a reflection from the train windows show that a mystery man is on the same train. He comes up to her and offers his business card. At the thought of seeing this handsome stranger once more, she takes his offer and arrives at a place called Peach Puff. What is this place? What are these people doing?

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "An Innocent Sin" (순결한 죄) by Oh Gye (오계).

After witnessing her boyfriend’s blatant extramarital affair and fleeing, Yu Na encounters an incredibly sexy and dangerous man named Jin, who is utterly consumed by desperation. Even the instinctive attraction he feels toward her seems to vanish for a fleeting moment—but Jin is an "alpha human-wolf" with abilities that place him at the very top of the human hierarchy! Yu Na is already reeling from being caught in a forbidden relationship, yet Jin harbors a deadly secret: to break a curse and survive, he must leave his mark on her. Will Yu Na be able to escape the alpha’s dangerous touch?
The story centers around Hawasoo, a duo in Muhan Sangsa where particularly suspicious and absurd incidents seem to happen nonstop.

After three years of an unconsummated marriage to Lee Won, noblewoman Kang Dan receives an ultimatum: become pregnant within one month or watch her husband take another wife. Desperate, she joins Joseon Seulhwapim, a secret circle where noble couples explore their hidden desires. There she meets Ju Heon, a free-spirited scholar who sees her as a woman rather than a duty. She soon discovers that Won has been involved with the circle for years. In the end, Kang Dan must choose her own path and the life she truly wants..

dramas.nt: 망돌이 된 최애가 귀신 붙어 찾아왔다
dramas.syn: When a fallen idol becomes possessed by a teenage ghost, his shaman superfan becomes his “ghost manager” to save his career, and him.

Every single day is a drama for Kim Yong, an ambitious newbie police officer.

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Policeman" (모두의 경찰) by Bulgeun Kokkiri (붉은코끼리).
After the bridal shower, the bride, Wang Ju Yeon, disappears, and everyone becomes a suspect.

A story about the youngest daughter, the black sheep of the family, who rebuilds her parents' lives after they were ruined by their children's foolishness.

A story that anticipates the victory of Gu Bok, a devoted daughter who illuminates the eyes of humans clouded by the demon of greed and continues to accumulate merit even amid a fierce and brutal family war.
Your former idol is now your biggest headache?! He may have lost his fans, but could he win her heart back?
